guide.villager_life.dialogue: Villagers react to actions, mobs, trading, danger, their surroundings, and each other.
guide.villager_life.cosmetics: Shear an adult villager for its nose. Interact with a villager to return a nose or give a Mayor Hat, Helmet, Microphone, or Moustache. Shears remove the current cosmetic first.
guide.villager_life.specials: Name villagers Testificate Man, Villager #5, Villager #9, or Villager Unreachable. Name a sheep Wooly The Sheep.
Put it out before the mayor writes a fine!
Fire at the doorstep — classic guest etiquette.
We did not order roof barbecue!
Someone decided to warm the village too literally.
The house is burning and you stand like at a fair!
Put it out, neighbors, stop taking selfies!
That is not a festive firework — that is our roof!
Village fire is my favorite nightmare genre.
Burning a bed is getting personal.
I sleep here, this is not a barbecue!
Pillows are not firewood, have a heart!
Keep that flint away from the mattress!
Burn the bed and you sleep outside with me.
Breaking stuff indoors is renovation without a quote.
At least leave the door on its hinges!
That is not creative redesign, that is vandalism.
The neighbors are watching, by the way.
That wall held the roof, thanks for the reminder.
Dumped water on me — refreshing, like a town-square shower.
I am not a crop, stop watering me!
Got a towel? Even an emotional one?
Warn me next time, captain bucket!
A door was a free option, just saying!
I am not a zoo exhibit!
Take the walls down before I call the mayor.
You sealed the door — we are conceptually home now.
Dig the entrance back open, please!
How do I go to work through a wall?
We have not officially moved out!
You killed the golem — who hugs us with iron now?
That was a guard, not a training dummy!
Iron friend down. Village mourning… and unsafe.
Hope your conscience is iron too.
Thanks, the village guardian is scrap now.
Build a new one if you are having fun.
Explosion by the village — ears ringing, roofs too.
At least warn us with the bell!
A crater as a landmark? No thank you.
Fix the fence if any fence remains.
Loud. Dusty. Totally unapproved by the council.
A big cannon by the village — subtle hint.
Aim at the sky, not the barn!
Artillery on the square. The mayor will love it… no.
Point it at the wasteland over there.
A shell exploded nearby — fireworks for the brave.
Return the ears if you find them.
Shell crater — a new flower bed?
At least a month of gossip material.
Holding a shell like a bouquet — romantic and dangerous.
Do not drop it by the well!
Munitions in hand — we take a step back. Two steps.
A gun in hand — the village goes quieter than a whisper.
Point the barrel at the sky, hero.
With that thing you do not look like a peaceful trader.
The barrel shines. Emeralds can shine safer.
Gunfire nearby — hide behind the barrels!
Who set up a shooting range on the square?
Shot echoes across the yards. Chickens filed a complaint.
More gears — the village will soon ring like a factory.
Who ordered a plant on the square?
Serious machines, and we still live like peasants.
At least keep the grease off the crops.
Building technical miracles next to the henhouse.
The chickens already out-noise the bell.
Contraption anchor — a circus on rails is incoming.
Building the wagon of the future in our yard?
Just do not crush the pumpkins.
Contraption ready to roll — selling tickets or running?
We are waving handkerchiefs for now.
Breaking Create machines — engineers cry oil.
At least pick up the screws!
The mechanism was suffering, and you smash it further.
Repairs are on you… almost joking.
Gears scattered like gossip across the square.
Collect at least half of them.
You roar by on a contraption — we wave handkerchiefs!
A train through the village — romance and hazard in one.
A technical marvel rolls past. Hats leave first.
Smells like diesel — the village became a petrol station.
Close the windows or get used to it?
Fuel is leaking, and so is the mood.
Move those cans away from the well.
The scent of progress tickles nose and conscience.
A vein drill — you are a geologist with attitude.
Just do not drill into our cellar!
The ground shakes with joy… or terror.
The hole grows faster than rumors.
A pot on the square — lunch is declared open!
We will bring bowls… and gossip.
The skillet hisses louder than politics.
The kitchen moved outdoors. We do not mind.
Just do not burn the fence.
Ad Astra space gear — the village is almost in orbit.
Do not forget oxygen for the chickens.
A rocket in the yard. The mayor requested an evacuation plan.
Orbital parts next to the well.
An oxygen bucket — rare orbital souvenir.
Do not drink it, even if it feels cosmic.
Rocket fuel next to the hay. Bold.
We will step aside just in case.
A CC computer — magic with blinking lights.
Will it write us poems or taxes?
An iron head thinks faster than the village council.
Buttons click more importantly than the bell.
A robot turtle wanders — chickens are confused.
Do not teach it to open chests!
A pet made of gears. Cute and suspicious.
A processor shell strolls the square.
Ritual gear — we pretend it is just crockery.
No spirits by the stove, okay?
Chalk and bowls. The evening promises weirdness.
Ritual whispers on the square. We whistle louder.
Botania flowers — pretty and a little witchy.
May we sniff them? Or do they sniff us?
A mystical flower bed. Bees filed for vacation.
An Aether frame — legends wake by the fence.
A portal to the sky. Chickens are already jealous.
A fairy-tale door stands in our yard.
What guest from the dimensions is that?! Hide kids and cheese!
A monster not from our woods. Nor the neighbors'.
An otherworld beast on the square. Tourism went wrong.
A gravestone — gloomy decor for the square.
We vote for flowers beside it.
A memory stone. A minute of silence… then a minute of gossip.
The monument stands. The mood sat down.
A Supplementaries oddity — another shelf surprise.
Explain the manual to a peasant!
Strange item, strange owner, excellent day.
We will put it in the chronicle.
Another useful thing we did not ask for.
A Comforts sleeping bag — a traveler's bed.
Just do not unroll it on my crops!
Sleep where you like, as long as you snore softer than pigs.
A camping bed on the square. Romance of a… hero tramp.
A Mekanism machine — the factory moved in unannounced.
Where do we queue for the tour?
Iron boxes hum smarter than me.
Wires, pipes, ambition. The village nods politely.
Reactor parts by the houses — bold interior design.
Keep the atom behind the hill!
You are boxing a sun. We are packing suitcases.
Joke. But the suitcases are nearby.
A reactor in the yard. The bell is already nervous.
Uranium in hand — glowing with pride or radiation?
Waste looks unappetizing even for compost.
A glowing souvenir. We pick a darker corner.
Create Nuclear reactor — kinetics with attitude.
Do not install this instead of a stove!
A nuclear setup in the yard. Neighbors write a petition.
Future power next to the henhouse.
A TFMG factory block — soot is already on the dinner menu.
Industry walks into the village in work boots.
The plant smells like tomorrow and yesterday's smoke.
Aeronautics parts — soon we fly with the chickens.
Building a flying saucer by the forge?
Do not clip the weather vane.
Wings on the ground. Ambition already in the clouds.
A jetpack — a walking firework with ego.
Take off away from the crops, please.
You look like a comet, only louder and closer.
We cheer from below… and squint.
Backpack flight. Chickens filed a noise complaint.
Tracks through the village — timetable romance.
Do not lay ties on the crops!
The railway grows faster than carrots.
Ties, spikes, dreams of a platform.
A train passes — we wave like on a dream platform!
Chug-chug past the windows. Curtains in shock.
So are we, in a good way.
The train carries gossip to the next biome.
Bring at least half of it back.
A potato cannon — weapon of the harvest!
Aim at targets, not the mayor.
Potatoes fly. Physics cries. We laugh.
A mechanical palm. We wave back carefully.
Shake hands with progress. It squeezes first.
May we have a piece too?
A gift that sticks hearts and fingers.
A diver helmet on land — bold fashion.
The well is nearby if you miss water.
You look like an aquarium that went for a walk.
Bubbles of ideas inside the helmet.
Do not explode the atmosphere… literally.
Spare air. Spare importance. Spare noise.
A CBC shell — not a juggling toy!
Hold tight and far from the well.
We do not share those ambitions.
Anti-rad injection — future medicine in a syringe.
Chamomile tea still works for us… probably.
Looks serious. We make a serious face.
A uranium rod — not a conductor's baton.
Conduct the safety orchestra farther away.
It glows with ambition. We dim with worry.
Return it to the reactor, maestro.
A wand of atomic power. Power scares us.
Atomic alloy — end of tech modesty.
Do not drop it on history's foot.
High tech in a palm. Low nerves for us.
An alloy that spins the village head.
A waystone scroll — a ticket without a queue.
Take us in a postcard from vacation!
Teleport paper. We hold our hats early.
One unfold — and you are gone. Mage classic.
Nature's compass — you seek adventure, we seek lunch.
Do not get lost… or get lost beautifully.
The needle spins, so does fate.
Return with gossip from far lands.
A pointer to wonders. We are a pointer to dinner.
A cooking-pot meal — the smell of victory over hunger!
Sit at the table, kitchen hero.
Food as art and as a bribe to the council.
We accept. Officially as a treat.
Aroma stronger than politics. We vote with noses.
Elytra plus thrust — a bird with a turbine.
Do not scare chickens with sonic booms!
Sky is open. So is the roof if careless.
We cheer and cross ourselves below.
A boss trophy — heroism on a shelf.
A story by the bell is mandatory!
You beat someone big. We are proud… from a safe distance.
Battle memory shines. We pale at the tale.
A spirit dictionary — do not read aloud by the stove.
The book whispers. We pretend to be deaf.
Knowledge from the other side. We are on this side, for now.
An oxygen tank — breathe deeper and more cosmic.
Splash some atmosphere for us too!
A heat generator — a pocket stove of the future.
Do not set it on a wooden stall!
Warms ambition and the air around.
Heat without firewood. Firewood is offended.
A rare dye — fashion on the square!
The fence will envy the curtains.
Not a vanilla color. Gossip will be colorful.
You tamed a beast — now we share a town-square pet!
Just keep it out of the cellar.
Hearts in the eyes and bones in the pocket. Classic.
We want friendship too… for carrots.
A new village friend. Old friends are already jealous.
The totem flashed — death got a formal rejection!
Immortality for a second. Gossip for a week.
You fell and stood up prettier than the mayor rises.
Shield took the hit — heroics with a wooden creak.
Blocked with a shield. We hid behind it morally.
The hit bounced. Pride did not.
But a lesson for the youth.
Enchantments settled — even the air got smarter.
The enchanting table whispers. We pretend we understood.
Magic in the item, skepticism in us.
Picking up XP — wisdom jingles in the pocket!
Green orbs — currency of heroes and envy.
Fine. We can do that… mentally.
Dimension change — hold hats and stomachs!
Send a Nether postcard without lava.
You vanished here and appeared somewhere worse.
The portal took a guest. The square is short on gossip.
Into the boat — square captain sets sail!
Floating transport. Chickens stay ashore to envy.
Boarded the boat. Politics stayed on the pier.
You mounted something weird — and we look weird watching.
Transport not in the village catalog.
Riding a surprise. We tip our hats.
You tossed an item — market of tears and freebies is open!
We do not pick it up. Almost.
Pick it up before pigs file a claim.
A throw from the heart… or a full inventory.
Tool broke — a moment of silence for the handle.
Got a spare? Or just attitude?
Crack — and progress stands on one leg.
The forge is already staring at you.
A broken tool is the best patience teacher.
And a reason to visit the smith with emeralds.
Potion ready — smell of science and mild trouble.
Do not drink by the well; it might work twice.
You brew wonders. We brew gossip in parallel.
A bottle with attitude. Read the label aloud.
Lightning nearby — hair and gossip stand up!
Thunder like the bell, only angrier.
The sky clapped. We jumped in sync.
Just do not drink the puddle; it is local.
A hero's swim. We dry towels with our eyes.
A spyglass — now you know our secrets from afar!
Look far. Gossip is still closer.
What is past the hill — besides our business?
Hero optics. We fixed our hair early.
An eye of ender looks where we fear to.
Toss carefully; it might find us.
An eye without a face. Creepy and useful.
A guiding nightmare in the palm.
Luck in the fortress; write us.
Book and quill — deadlier than a sword in clever hands.
Do not write mean things about us… or write them pretty.
A chronicle in progress. We pose modestly.
The mayor's autograph will cost more.
Ink smells like truth and exaggeration.
Read it aloud by the fire.
An archaeology brush — you dig the past from dirt.
Found our old debts? Return them quietly.
Cleaning history. We will sweep the present.
Brush of fate. Centuries of dust on boots.
Recovery compass — path to where you stopped being.
The needle remembers your death better than friends.
A navigator to your own ending. Philosophical gadget.
Just come back alive this time.
Diamonds! The village suddenly became your best friend.
Share the sparkle, not only stares.
Blue stone of happiness. The pickaxe tired prettily.
We already count how many fences… joke.
Find of the square's century. Chronicle it big.
Thanks to the cow from the whole stomach.
A bucket of milk. Cookies sense nearby.
Milking with witnesses. The cow keeps dignity.
Milk drunk — all effects panicked and fled!
White antidote of fate. Milk mustache optional.
A sip of calm. Potions retired.
Honey — sweet diplomacy in the throat.
Bees are proud somewhere. So are we, on your dime.
One more sip and the mayor smiles.
Leave a drop on bread for a neighbor.
Horn blasted — village combat-ready… for tea.
Warn us with a schedule next time.
Feeding animals — farm karma rises visibly!
We are hungry too… joke. Almost.
Hearts over a snout. Diplomacy works.
Leave a handful for square chickens too.
Treat accepted. Tail wags the report.
Pasture hero of the day — you.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.life_ki: The day is treating us kindly.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.life_so: I have nothing kind to say.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.life_ho: Do not touch my door again.
Thank you. The house looks better.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.life_jo: The armor stand can wait. The bench cannot.
I keep the edge on the stone.
The pen is up. One cow is enough.
Meat comes after the fence.
A candle is enough for tonight.
I keep a small light by the bed.
The row is in. It will come up.
Seed goes in the ground, not in a chest.
The barrel stays dry until the catch.
I work from a barrel, not a dock.
The target faces away from the door.
Arrows need a wall that can take them.
The cauldron is for hides, not soup.
I need water and a fire nearby.
The lectern gets the good light.
Books stay off the floor.
Hay first, then the fence.
The flock needs a corner, not a palace.
The grindstone earns its place.
Tools before trinkets.
The smithing table is not a shelf.
I leave room to swing.

handbook.villager_life.mood.intro: Each village keeps a mood from -100 to +100. When it crosses a threshold, villagers build the strongest rite it allows first, then the lesser ones. Pick a rite to see its build.
info.villager_life.altar_core: The furnace heart of the Tocsin Forge. It glows hotter as villagers feed it iron and toll the bell.
info.villager_life.forge_steps:
1. Villagers gather in a ring around the forge.
2. They throw six iron ingots into the furnace.
3. The bell tolls three times and an iron frame rises.
4. The Tocsin Golem awakens. Strike its open back, ring village bells to stun it, or answer its toll with the elder's staff.
Break the forge or flood it during the chant to stop the rite.
info.villager_life.handbook: Opens the Villager Life guide, including the Village Mood section with every rite and its build.
info.villager_life.staff: Hold use to charge the little bell for a second, then release: the village mood rises by 10. Sneak to curse it by 10 instead. Tolling it while the Tocsin Golem raises its own bell stuns the golem.
info.villager_life.tocsin_core: The cooled heart of the Tocsin Golem. Every player who fought the golem gets one.
rite.villager_life.build_altar.desc: Angry villagers build a forge around the bell. Fed with iron, it wakes the Tocsin Golem.
rite.villager_life.build_festival.desc: Barrels, cakes and a festive totem. Villagers gather to dance and trade a little cheaper.
rite.villager_life.build_festoon.desc: The first sign of a content village: banners, potted flowers and lanterns strung over the square.
rite.villager_life.build_monument.desc: A stone monument to the player the village loves. Its plaque remembers the deeds that raised it.
rite.villager_life.build_mourning.desc: Black banners, wither roses and a mourning totem: villagers grieve for what they lost.
rite.villager_life.build_pavilion.desc: A striped pavilion around the bell: the village is as happy as it gets.
rite.villager_life.build_pyre.desc: Logs, crying obsidian and a soul campfire: the village burns its grudges in the open.
rite.villager_life.build_vigil.desc: White candles and soul lanterns. The village is worried and keeps watch at night.
Everyone to the forge. Stand in a ring, iron in hand.
A ring round the furnace. No ingot, you just watch.
We are not forging horseshoes today. We forge an answer.
Work the bellows! Everyone must hear the tocsin.
Iron into the fire. Grudges too.
The bell strikes three times. After that, sorry is too late.
Another ingot! The forge is hungry, like us in winter.
Throw straighter, it is a forge, not a fair.
Third toll! Get indoors, it is about to stand.
Traveller, better run. Or flood the forge while you can.
Bolt the doors. It hates being watched.
It is awake. The iron remembers every grudge.
The Tocsin Golem! Hit its back, the furnace is there.
Hear the bell? That is not the dinner bell.
It shed its plates! Watch your feet, they crawl.
Armour is flying off. So it hurts.
Ring our bells! They deafen it.
The bell cracked! Now it charges through everything.
Steam from its chest. Step back when it hisses.
The last push. Its and ours.
Third toll. The frame rises on its own.
Do not stare into the fire. It stares back.
Quiet. You can hear the iron breathe.
It went back into the forge. Not for good, just asleep.
Nobody to fight, so it cooled down. Lucky us.
The forge is quiet. Fuel it again next week.
Bring the flags! The square earned a festoon.
Flowers in pots, lanterns on posts.
Nobody can stop us living pretty. Especially today.
Festival! Barrels to the bell, hands off the cakes.
The harvest is in. Now we eat it.
If you do not dance, you carry barrels.
Raising a pavilion. Yellow, like our mood.
Wool on the roof, logs on the corners.
The next village will see this pavilion. Let them envy.
Light the candles. We keep watch tonight.
Soul lanterns by the bell. It feels safer.
Someone circles the village. Nobody sleeps.
Black banners. We remember who we lost.
Wither roses, for those who did not come back.
Let us be quiet. Today at least.
Logs in a pile. We burn everything that built up.
A soul fire burns cold. Like our hearts.
A little more, and it will come to the forge.
The festoon is up! The square looks like a postcard.
The flags flutter. So do we, from joy.
The festival begins! Traders, discounts on the table.
Music, cakes, nobody quarrels. A miracle.
To the harvest! And to whoever saved it.
The pavilion stands. Only cats are happier.
Under this pavilion even the mayor is kind.
The village never had a better day.
The candles burn. Let them see we are awake.
The vigil has begun. We take turns.
Quiet. We listen to the night.
Mourning. No trading, no jokes today.
The banners are up. We remember.
The totem stands. Let it grieve for us.
The pyre burns. The anger burns with it.
Crying obsidian does not lie. We are not well.
If this does not help, we light the forge.
tooltip.villager_life.villager_blessing_: Hold use, then release: village mood +10. Sneak to curse it by 10.
tooltip.villager_life.parish_vestment: In a village: regeneration while the mood is above zero, mining fatigue below.
tooltip.villager_life.tocsin_core: Core for the blessing staff and the parish vestment.
tooltip.villager_life.handbook: Use to read how village life works.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.life_ws: Time to set up my workshop.
A few planks, and it will be a real workshop.
Someone took my workshop apart. I will fix it.
Planks are missing again. Fine, I will patch it.
tooltip.villager_life.seed_sacks: Holds 256 seeds. Each morning sows empty farmland within 4 blocks.
tooltip.villager_life.harvest_basket: Collects dropped crops within 4 blocks. Empty hand takes them out.
tooltip.villager_life.chopping_block: Put a log on it and hit it three times with an axe for six planks.
tooltip.villager_life.meat_rack: Hang up to 4 raw meats; they cure into cooked meat in a quarter of a day.
tooltip.villager_life.wool_bales: Holds 256 wool. While stocked, a sheared sheep nearby regrows its wool every 30 seconds.
tooltip.villager_life.spinning_wheel: Spins one wool into three string. Slow.
tooltip.villager_life.fish_rack: Hang up to 4 raw fish; they dry into cooked fish in a quarter of a day.
tooltip.villager_life.tackle_crate: Stores 9 stacks. Fishing within 8 blocks sometimes brings an extra catch.
tooltip.villager_life.feather_basket: A chicken nearby drops a feather into it now and then, up to 16.
tooltip.villager_life.book_stack: Holds up to 4 books; with any book it adds one level of enchanting power.
tooltip.villager_life.ink_and_quill: Copies a written book onto a book and quill. Slow.
tooltip.villager_life.globe: Click to turn it; it points toward the village bell.
tooltip.villager_life.map_rolls: Holds 64 empty maps. Empty hand takes a map of the village.
tooltip.villager_life.incense_burner: Burns blaze powder; while lit, regenerates people within 6 blocks.
tooltip.villager_life.potion_shelf: Displays 3 potions; a comparator reads how full it is.
tooltip.villager_life.hide_rack: Stretch up to 4 rotten flesh; each turns into leather in a day.
tooltip.villager_life.leather_rolls: Holds 64 leather and mends hung leather armor, one leather a minute.
tooltip.villager_life.chisel_bench: Carves bricks: plain makes cracked, with vine or moss mossy, with a nugget chiseled.
tooltip.villager_life.brick_pallet: Holds 256 bricks of one kind; the stack grows as it fills.
tooltip.villager_life.armor_dummy: Wears up to 4 armor pieces for display.
tooltip.villager_life.chainmail_rack: Links chain into chainmail; a leather piece sets the shape.
tooltip.villager_life.tool_rack: Holds 4 tools and slowly mends them with nuggets from a nail keg within 3 blocks.
tooltip.villager_life.nail_keg: Holds 256 iron nuggets for tool racks nearby.
tooltip.villager_life.sword_barrel: Load flint, then click with a sword: +1 damage for the next 20 hits.
tooltip.villager_life.greenhouse_box: Grows a seed with bone meal into a small harvest. Slow.
tooltip.villager_life.smokehouse: Smokes meat and fish slowly, spending half the fuel of a smoker.
tooltip.villager_life.dye_vat: Dyes four wool at once with a single dye.
tooltip.villager_life.fish_trap: Place it in water and bait it with bread, wheat or rotten flesh; a fish now and then.
tooltip.villager_life.reading_desk: Studies a book with three lapis into a random enchanted book. Very slow.
tooltip.villager_life.survey_table: Draws an empty map and four paper into a wide map of the area.
tooltip.villager_life.font: Brews a potion with an ingredient; blaze powder lasts 20 brews.
tooltip.villager_life.tanning_vat: Tans 4 rabbit hides or 8 rotten flesh into leather.
tooltip.villager_life.kiln: Fires clay, sand and stone, spending half the fuel of a furnace.
tooltip.villager_life.armor_bench: Mends armor by a quarter with one piece of its material.
tooltip.villager_life.grinding_wheel: Mends tools by a quarter with one piece of their material.
tooltip.villager_life.weapon_forge: Mends a weapon by a quarter and sharpens it for 20 hits.
message.villager_life.globe.bell: The bell is %s blocks to the %s
handbook.villager_life.workshop.fletchin: Fletching Table: flint, stick and feather make six arrows; eight arrows and a lingering potion make tipped arrows. Works while the menu is open.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_mon: I'm not scared! Well... maybe a little.
It looked at me! It totally looked at me!
If I close my eyes, it can't see me.
I'm gonna call the golem, you know!
It's scarier than in the stories.
Can I sleep with you tonight?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_def: That's not fair! He didn't do anything!
When I grow up, I'll show everyone!
Does it hurt? I'll blow on it and it'll go away.
You can't do that! That's a bad thing to do!
I'll kick your knee, I will!
Don't you know fighting is bad?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_dea: Is he... is he not getting up?
I don't want it to be like this.
Mom, why is everyone so quiet?
I'll draw a picture of him every day.
Can I just sit here for a while?
It's not true. Tell me it's not true!
I'll be really, really good, just bring him back.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_fir: I'll get my bucket! Oh, it has a hole.
It wasn't me! Honest, it wasn't me!
My toys are still in there!
Who was playing with fire? Own up!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_boo: Can you do it again? Just not on our house.
I fell down! The ground jumped!
Now there's a hole! A huge one!
Was that a creeper? I didn't see it!
Now I'll be scared of loud noises.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_rai: Yay, puddles! Can I jump in them?
I'm all wet, like a fish!
I'm catching raindrops on my tongue!

subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_w_gra: Everything at home is as it was. Only you are missing.
I've brought you flowers. Your favourites.
The children remember you. And so do I.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_w_god: What a wonderful name! You'll be the godparent.
The little one will wear that name with pride.
Come and see us. We feed godparents here.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_w_sco: And who promised to bring food? Who, I ask you?
Then make your own dinner! If you can find anything.
And don't look at me like that.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_w_mak: All right, peace. But this is the last time!
Let's go home. I'll make something.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_w_can: I'll light a candle so the windows glow.
Evening. Time to come home, everyone.
Let the little flame burn. It's cosier.
A candle burning means someone's waiting at home.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_w_eld: Come here, children. Granny will tell you a tale.
When I was little, zombies walked the village at night. But we weren't afraid!
The most important things in life are a warm home and kind neighbours.
My first pie burned. The second didn't. That's all the wisdom there is.
Don't pull each other's braids. Or I'll tell your mother.
Oh, old age is no joy. But with you it is.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_w_fun: Bright be your memory. We won't forget you.
The village is one kind heart smaller.
Rest in peace. We'll look after yours.
May the flowers by the stone never fade.
vnap.wedding.wish: %s asks you for a wedding gift: %s
vnap.wedding.invite: %s is getting married at the bell — you are invited!
tooltip.villager_life.pet_bowl: A family feeds its dog or cat here every morning.
tooltip.villager_life.cat_bed: A wicker basket with a cushion. The family cat naps here.
tooltip.villager_life.parrot_perch: A perch for the family parrot.
tooltip.villager_life.aquarium: Fish swimming among the weed. Children love to watch it.
tooltip.villager_life.pet_treat: Give it to a family's pet, or to a stray the children are taming.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_k_wan: Look, someone's wandering out there! Can we keep it?
Mum, Dad, I want a pet! Please!
It's all alone. It needs a home!
I'll feed it myself, I promise, I really promise!
Can I make friends with it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_k_tam: Don't be scared, I brought you something tasty.
Come here, little one. Just a bit closer.
Eat, eat. I'll bring more tomorrow.
It's not running away any more! It trusts me!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_k_nam: It's ours now! What shall we call it?
I've thought of a name! The best one!
Hooray! We've got a pet now!
You're part of the family now. Don't run away, all right?
This is the best day of my life!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_k_fet: Find the stick! Where's the stick?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_k_goo: Good dog! Clever dog! Here's a treat.
He brought it! He brought it back! Did you see?
You're the smartest dog in the world!
Tomorrow I'll teach you to shake a paw.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_k_mis: Where's my friend? Isn't he coming back?
Can I put a flower for him?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_m_wel: Well, welcome to the family, beastie.
No sleeping on the bed! Well... maybe sometimes.
One more mouth in the house. Fine, we'll manage.
The children already adore it. No way out now.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_m_ken: A dog needs a home of its own. A kennel it is!
Right, planks, nails... and where's my hammer?
I'll build a kennel better than the neighbours'.
Stop getting under my feet, it's for you!
A small house is still a house.
Done! In you go, make yourself at home.
A fine kennel. The roof doesn't leak, I checked.
There's your house and your bowl. On guard!
Ah, I wish I had such peace and quiet.
Now everyone in the family has a roof of their own.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_w_wel: Come here, sweetie. You're ours now.
Paws wiped at the door! I mean it.
Oh, one more child in the house.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_w_tam: Here, kitty... or whatever you are. Come, I'll feed you.
Don't be afraid, I don't bite.
Come again tomorrow. I'll be waiting.
A little longer and you'll be ours.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_w_pet: Fur all over the house... but how can I be cross with you?
Sit with me for a bit.
You listen better than my husband.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_w_mis: The bowl's still there, but no one to eat from it.
A good one. The very best.
The children are crying. And so am I.
May you be warm wherever you are.
advancements.villager_life.family.pet.de: See a village family adopt a pet
tooltip.villager_life.dog_kennel: A family's dog sleeps here; the head of the house puts it up in the yard.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.p_w_tea: Say "Hello, hello!" Clever bird, say it!
Say "Good morning!" Clever bird, say it!
Say "Who's there?" Clever bird, say it!
Say "Dinner's ready!" Clever bird, say it!
Say "Pretty bird!" Clever bird, say it!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.p_m_tea: Come on, say it: "Want a cracker!"
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.p_w_tea: Say "Want a cracker!" Clever bird, say it!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.p_k_tea: Say "Want a cracker!" Go on, please!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.p_m_tea: Come on, say it: "Hush, the baby's asleep!"
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.p_w_tea: Say "Hush, the baby's asleep!" Clever bird, say it!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.p_k_tea: Say "Hush, the baby's asleep!" Go on, please!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.p_w_tea: Say "Good night!" Clever bird, say it!
Monday again! Time to get back to work. I do not know what my work is, but I am very behind on it.
You look how Monday feels, strange Villager. That is a compliment. I think.
It's Saturday! I'm going to sleep in until the sun is... up. So, the normal time. But it FEELS different!
Picking crops in front of the farmer — brave. Return the carrot, he remembers everything!
That is not tasting, that is a garden raid!
Next time at least say hello.
The farmer is staring. The farmer does not blink.
Put the veggie back, field hero.
Dust in the eyes — and you are gone. Rude but flashy.
Someone teleported away. Only gossip remains. And we will keep it going.
A stylish disappearance. Come back later. With souvenirs.
Looks smart. We nod as if we understood.
Symbols dance. We pretend it is a font.
A Twilight Forest relic — a fairy tale with teeth.
Tell it by the fire? No summoning, please.
A trophy from the mist. The village respects… from afar.
The forest sent a souvenir. We send a polite decline. With flowers.
A contraption in the sky — wave and hold your hats! Bird? Plane? Your blueprint?
Flying over the village — the post will be jealous.
Do not drop nuts on the roofs!
A shadow from above. Not a dragon. Worse — an engineer.
A schematic in hand — a dangerous person with a plan.
Show the blueprint, we will pretend to read.
Paper rustles with a future factory.
The drawing looks confident. The village does not. Yet.
A radar part — you see everyone, and that unsettles us.
Do not scan other chests without asking!
Watch the sky. We watch you with a schematic.
The screen knows more gossip than the square. Almost.
The Geiger clicks gossip about radiation.
Clicks like applause for a bad decision.
Keep it away from the milk.
The device counts trouble. We count steps back. In sync.
Yellow cake… wait, that's yellowcake. Not for the tea table!
Looks like pastry, acts like a problem.
A sweetness you must not share with neighbors.
Osmium shines like a denied discount.
Heavy metal, light hint of wealth.
An ingot from the future in a peasant's palm. We envy politely.
A crude oil bucket — scent of success and stains on reputation.
Do not pour near the well!
Liquid wealth. And the air gets poorer. Air out the square, please.
Explorer's compass — a map with attitude. Bring back a souvenir, not a monster.
Needle to ruins. Us to the stove.
A traveler's backpack — a home in a roll.
Any tea from the side pocket?
You wear inventory like a life philosophy.
A home on your back. Missing a door. And a doormat.
A computer turtle — an IT pet.
Teach it not to open our chests.
A robot house in your hand. Cute and worrying.
A guide book — a smart person in the village, rare!
You flip knowledge. We flip bread prices.
Pages rustle with wisdom. We rustle approval. Quietly, so we can hear.
A catch! The fish is as surprised as you are. Fry it, or let it go with a lecture?
The hook worked. The village applauds quietly.
Fishing here is sport and gossip at once.
Tell us how big the lie was.
Bow drawn — sparrows already on vacation.
The bow looks serious. We look careful.
An arrow is not gossip; you cannot take it back.
Tight as the village council's nerves. Let go gentler than politics does.
The anvil clangs — your levels weep. But the sword is polite again.
A stylish repair with a 6 a.m. neighbor soundtrack.
Broke — fixed — told the tale. Hero cycle.
Leave us a scrap for memory.
Back with us! Death did not love you enough.
Tell what you saw while we panicked?
Respawn — the square's best magic trick.
Next time fetch the loot back too.
You're back. The chickens exhaled. So did we. No need to ring the alarm.
A hot treasure out of the furnace! Smells like progress and a little scorch.
Hot craft. Cold fingers — your problem.
We offer a moral oven mitt.
Smelting done. Envy just starting. Share an ingot, be human.
And do not stand under a tree with a pickaxe.
The sky's in a bad mood. Ours is fine — under a roof. Come in, the ceiling barely drips.
Thunder argues with the bell. The bell is still politer.
You are on fire — that is not a fashion accessory!
Water, dirt, a panda… anything, just put it out!
A little flame on the player. We already call a bucket.
Burning bright is not meant literally! To the water, quick!
Totem in hand — a pocket plan B against fate.
Do not drop it; it gets offended.
Life insurance in your pocket. We approve the paranoia. Golden caution.
Keep the totem closer to the heart and farther from lava.
Ancient debris — smells of the Nether and importance. Just don't smelt it by the bakery, please.
We will step away from sparks.
You mined what the ground hid on purpose.
Torch placed — darkness filed a complaint.
A spark of civilization on the wall. Monsters will mind; we will not.
One more by the well, please.
The eye flew to find trouble — hero classic!
A toss toward the End. Dinner will wait… probably. Come back before the mood goes sour.
The eye left. The secret left with it.
A story is mandatory on return.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e01mood: Village mood is rising — smiles wider, prices softer.
Something in the air… and it is not only fresh bread.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e02mood: Mood is dropping faster than a griefer's reputation.
Neighbors look sideways. Sideways and very specific.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e03mood: Gather up! Time to build something postcard-worthy.
Stones, hands, pathos — classic village kit.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e04mood: Quiet… we need darker stone and shorter conscience.
Everyone to the square. No torches. Especially no torches.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e05mood: Laying starts. Someone holds the level — others pretend.
First block matters. Second too. Third as well.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e07mood: Another brick! Architecture is melodrama with mortar.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e08mood: Dark stone set. Let it scare the pigeons.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e09mood: Consecrating the monument! Bell, tears, a minute of pathos.
Let this pillar remind us: we can build and forgive.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e10mood: The altar breathes. Metaphorically. We hope.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e11mood: Monument defiled! Village history just got slapped.
Break a monument, and your karma breaks with it.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e12mood: Altar ready. We could have skipped this. Too late now.
Red pulse. Bad sign. Very bad.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.e17mood: Ritual interrupted! Village exhales — even smiles.
Thanks for the bucket. Seriously. Thanks.
You smashed the altar at the feast.
The mood just fell off a cliff.
The feast is over. We were happy, and then you showed up.
One swing, and the village remembers how to hate.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.life_wa: Stay a while. We have room.
Good to see a friendly face.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.life_jo: The map table goes by the wall.
I need a flat place to draw.
The cutter stays where the chips fall.
Stone dust stays off the bed.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.w_greet: Oh, hello! Come in, don't be shy.
Hello, traveler. You look thoughtful today.
Hmm… you again? Well, tell me what's new.
Why are you staring? Is something on my nose?
Good day! How was the road, are you tired?
Oh, you scared me! Sneaking up is not nice.
Hi there! Will you help me with my basket?
Our hero! Thank you for everything.
Without you, the raiders would've gotten us long ago.
The kids talk about nothing but you.
Come for dinner tonight, I'll make your favorite.
You're the best neighbor we've ever had.
I knitted you a scarf. Well, almost.
The whole village is grateful to you.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.m_widow: She's gone… How can this be?
I'll keep her things. Every single one.
Kids, it's just us now. We'll manage.
Without her songs the house is so quiet.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.w_teach: Backs straight, hands on the desk. Let's begin.
Three carrots, you eat one. How many left? No, not zero!
Today's story is about a dragon. A kind one, don't worry.
Who wants to read? Don't be shy, I'll help.
Class dismissed! Off you go, and no mischief.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.w_decor: A little beauty at home never hurts.
I'll put it here. No, here. Yes, like that!
Now our place is like the mayor's. Even nicer!
My husband won't even notice. But I did!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_k_cou: One, two, three, four, five, ready or not, here I come!
Counting to ten! No peeking! Almost.
Hide well, I'll find you all!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_w_lea: Time I built a nest of my own. Somewhere further off.
I'll take only what I need. And him.
Oh, so many roads! Which one to take?
Don't miss me! I'll send pies. Somehow.
Wherever we stop, there'll be a new village.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_k_fis: Look, a fish! That orange one!
Do fish sleep? They never close their eyes.
Hi, fishies! I'm waving at you!
I want to be a fish. Swim all day.
One, two, three... I lost count again.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_w_fee: Breakfast is served! Come and eat.
A full bowl. And you say nobody loves you.
Eat up, or you'll waste away.
Looking at me like he hasn't eaten in a week again.
A plate for everyone, and one for you too.
Who's hungry here? You, of course.
A firearm on display — trade freezes.
Lower it and prices live again.
The barrel shines. We prefer emerald shine.
A gun as an accessory. Bad accessory.
At least hide it behind your back.
A backpack the size of a barn — are you moving?
Or is the barn moving with you?
So many pockets, and kindness fits in one? Joke. I hope there is plenty of kindness too.
A warehouse on your shoulders. Shops envy silently.
An extendo grip — a handshake from the next field.
Do not poke noses with it, please!
With that arm, fence disputes end quickly.
The long arm of justice… or of jokes. Choose jokes.
A sweep attack — a fan of trouble for foes!
For grass too, by the way.
Sweep like a hero's broom. Yard cleaner, monsters not. Thanks from the fence.
Wide swing. Narrow dodge chance for the creeper.
A goat horn — signal for panic or a party? Blow softer; chickens have hearts.
Nature's musical instrument. The neighbors already know. Literally.
Honk of fate. We covered ears and pride. Once more and the bell gets jealous.
Bucket filled — progress with a splash!
Do not mix water and lava. Again.
You scooped an element. The element is mildly offended.
A full bucket — full plans. We love the intrigue. Just do not pour on the porch.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_001: Are the clouds soft there? Can you sleep on them?
I will peek in with just one eye!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_002: Allay, bring me a cookie! Please!
It's blue and it sings! I want one too!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_003: The bee is chasing me! Mum!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_004: A baby! Can I name it? Let it be Fluffy!
It is so tiny! Will it play with me?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_005: A baby bee! Can I pet it?
Will it sting me? It's so little.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_006: Mum, can it sleep in my bed?
It just bopped my nose with its paw!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_007: It's peeping! Can I hold it?
I'll call it Crumb. No, Fluffy!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_008: It licked me! With a scratchy tongue!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_009: When it grows up, I'm going to ride it!
It kicks so funny! Look, look!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_010: It's doing somersaults! I can do that too!
Can I hug it? Just once!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_011: It oinked at me! Oink to you too!
Piggy, do you want my carrot?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_012: The lamb is jumping! Like me!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_013: A wolf pup! It growls like a kitty!
Can it be mine? I'll give it a bone!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_014: Mum! It runs faster than me!
I don't want to play with you! Go away!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_015: Mum! There's a mean piglet with a sword!
He's little like me and he's got a sword!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_016: He used to play with me! Why is he green?
Can't catch me, can't catch me! Oh no, he can!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_017: A bat! They sleep upside down, I know!
Mum, it squeaks! Can I keep it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_018: The bee is buzzing right by my ear!
Will it give me honey if I ask nicely?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_019: Can I put a stone in? The smallest one!
Will it be taller than the bell tower? Tallest ever?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_020: That flower winked at me! Really truly!
I will pick one for Mum. Will she be cross?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_021: It bubbles and fizzes! Is it magic soup?
If I drink it, will I turn invisible?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_022: Can I ride it? I'll hold on tight!
It's chewing and chewing! What is it eating?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_023: The kitty's purring! Really, really loud!
It brought me a dead mouse. Yuck!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_024: The chicken's chasing me! No wait, I'm chasing it!
Can I collect the eggs? I'll be careful!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_025: I got a present! A real one! Look!
Did you bring me something shiny?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_026: I can't sleep! Is it tomorrow yet?
Mum hid the presents. I know where!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_027: A little copper man! Will it play with me?
It pressed a button! Can I press it too?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_028: The cow is huge! Bigger than Dad!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_029: What did you make? Show me! Is it for me?
I can build with sticks too! I will show you at home!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_030: Mum, the tree is looking at me. Really looking!
I'm never going mushroom picking again. Never!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_031: I'm not a zombie anymore? Can I go to Mum?
Ew, my mouth tastes like rotten flesh.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_032: A dolphin! Can I swim with it?
It jumped! It jumped so high!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_033: Can you hit that pumpkin over there? Bet you cannot!
Let me pull the string once! Just to see!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_034: It glows purple! Is the sword magic now?
The book turns its own pages! Scary and cool!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_035: A dragon! A real one! Is it coming here?
I'm not scared! Well... a little bit.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_036: A fish! Can I catch it with my hands?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_037: A frog! I'll take it home in my pocket!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_038: Flags! Can I hang the red one?
Will the lanterns glow at night? Every single one?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_039: A tent! I will play hide-and-seek under it!
Yellow like a chick! I love it!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_040: Blue fire! Why is it not hot?
Can I throw a stick in the fire?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_041: A festival! Will there be sweets? Say there will!
I will dance until it is dark!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_043: Boo! Did I scare you? Say yes!
Sweets, or I'll throw eggs at your house!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_044: Can I fly on it? Please, please!
It's like a giant pillow in the sky!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_045: Ow! The witch threw a bottle at me!
I'm telling my mum, you mean witch!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_046: You beat it? All by yourself? Tell me!
Can I touch it? It will not come alive, right?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_047: A cake! Is it hot? Can I have a piece?
Mum said I cannot eat it. Can I lick it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_048: Did you see fish? What kind? Big ones?
Can I shout into the helmet? It will echo!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_049: A honey apple! I will wash my hands, promise!
Half for me, half for my little sister!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_050: Boom! The potato flew all the way to the woods!
Let me shoot once! I will hit the barrel!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_051: You are like a bird! A big noisy bird!
Do a loop! Please, just one loop!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_052: Wow, a long arm! Scratch my back!
Get my ball off the roof, please!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_053: Give me a ride! Please, please!
Its tail looks like my sister's braid!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_054: Golem, throw me up high, really high!
He gave me a flower! It's for me!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_055: Run faster! The golem is slow!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_056: He's riding! I want a ride too!
A little one on a big one! Like me on Dad!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_057: Ow ow ow! It's hot! Mum, get me out!
I thought it was red juice!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_058: A llama! Does it really spit? Show me!
Its neck is so long! Like a ladder!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_060: The world has a birthday? Is it very old?
Can I blow out the candles? Can I?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_061: A boat! I want to come, I will be captain!
Do the fish bite out there? Are there squids?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_062: A horsey! Give me a ride, I am light!
I will give her a carrot, and you lift me up!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_063: Wow! Can I sit behind you?
It will not bite? Tell me it will not bite!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_064: Yay, I'm upside down! Look, I'm an acrobat!
Whoa, everything's spinning and my hat's falling!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_065: I'm all colours! I'm like a rainbow!
Look, I'm flashing now! So cool!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_066: I stayed up all night! Almost!
Happy New Year! I'm a whole year older now!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_067: The panda sleeps on its back! Can I lie on it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_068: Parrot, say my name! Go on, say it!
It's dancing! It dances better than Dad!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_069: It's too big, but I'll grow into it!
So heavy! Does Dad wear this?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_070: It sparkles! I'm a knight like in the stories!
Mum, look, magic armour! Can I keep it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_071: Green orbs! They ding when you catch them!
Will you leave me an orb? Just a little one!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_072: I found it! It's my treasure now!
Whoa, what's this? Can you eat it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_073: A pig! Can I ride it?
Its tail is all curly! So funny!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_074: Are we going to fly? I get the first seat, okay?
I will see our house from the sky! And Mum!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_075: Can I have a ride? I will hold on tight!
Will it move by itself? With no horse at all?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_076: It spins! Can I turn the big wheel?
When I grow up, I'll build a machine too!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_077: A rocket! A real one! Take me to the moon!
Are there other kids on the moon?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_078: Tracks! Can I balance on them like a log?
Will the train whistle? Choo choo!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_079: Whoa! A real cannon! Can I sit on it?
Does it go boom? How big a boom?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_080: The lights blink! Can it play games?
Can I press a button? Just one!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_081: What is cooking? Can I lick the spoon?
I can help stir! I know how, honestly!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_082: I am counting bricks! A hundred already! Or ten!
Can I press my handprint right here?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_083: Ding-dong! Can I bang on it too?
Play the song about the cow! Please!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_084: A white bear! Like my toy, only big!
Bear, do you want a fish? I'll give you one!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_085: A bunny! Can I pet it?
I can jump higher than the bunny! Watch!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_086: Ouch! Does it hurt? You need to blow on it!
I didn't look, I closed my eyes!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_087: That fire looks magic! How does it burn like that?
I will just poke it with a stick, only a bit.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_088: Green marbles! They're rolling towards me!
I caught one! And it vanished!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_089: A little one! I'll teach you to run!
He's smaller than me! I'm the big one now!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_090: Something is sitting in there and looking at me!
Ow, hot! I only wanted to touch it a little.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_091: Mum! There is a monster with three eyes!
I am not scared… I will just hold Mum's hand.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_092: Whoa, treasure! Can I take just one thing?
Mum, look, someone lost all their toys!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_094: What is that? Can I touch it?
Mum! A weird animal! Can we keep it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_095: Here, Mum gave me two apples.
Take half, I split it fair and square.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_097: The sheep is bald! Is it cold?
Ha, it looks like a piglet now!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_098: It's like jelly! Can I poke it?
Oh, it's jumping at me! Mummy!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_099: The Sniffer's big and friendly! Can I ride it?
It found something! What is it, what is it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_100: The snowman's alive! It throws snowballs!
Can I give it a carrot for a nose?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_101: He came out of an egg! Like a chick!
Mum, was I in an egg too?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_102: Night already? I haven't finished playing!
It's dark! Mum, are the monsters out yet?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_103: It's a stinky cube! Ha ha, stinky!
Can I feed it my pebble?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_104: Ooh, the ingot is glowing! Can I touch it? A tiny bit?
Will anything else come out of the furnace? More!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_105: Can I pet him? He does not bite?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_106: A puppy! It's wagging its tail!
Doggy, fetch the stick! Go on, fetch!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_107: Mum, it is glowing! Is it alive?
I am not scared! Well, a little scared.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_108: The sun's running so fast! Like a bunny!
Again! Make the sun jump again!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_109: Mum! It is huge! Will it eat us?
There is fire in its belly, I saw it!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_110: Iron beetles! They are chasing me!
I climbed on the bench, they cannot reach me!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_111: We won! I helped too, I threw a stone!
Can I keep a piece of the bell?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_112: A turtle! Will it hide in its shell?
I'll race it! Oh, it's swum away already.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_113: A little turtle! It follows me around!
Can I take it home? I will walk it every day!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_114: Is that from the fairy-tale forest? Tell me about it!
Wow, it sparkles! Let me hold it!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_115: Can I toast bread on a stick?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_116: I sit at the front, I'm the lookout!
Will we sail all the way to the sea?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_117: Whoa, a green flash, and you are alive!
Can I have a little doll against dying too?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_118: Poof! Where did he go? I want to do that!
Mum, will he be back for supper?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_119: Presents soon! I've been good all year!
Can we build a snowman? Mum, please!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_121: Mum, your milk boiled over! April Fools!
I hid Dad's boots. It's a joke!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_122: Can I stay up till midnight tonight?
I'll wish for a puppy! No, two puppies!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_123: Hooray, no lessons! We play all day!
Dad's home today! He promised me a toy boat!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_124: Can I sit inside your backpack?
Do you have sweets in there? Just one?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_125: You are flying! Catch me up in the air!
When I grow up, I will fly like that too!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_126: Are you an astronaut? Show me how to hop on the moon!
Can I knock on the helmet? Knock knock!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_127: No lessons! I'm at the river all day!
Play tag with me! You're it!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_128: Mum, it has three heads! I'm scared!
I'll hide under the bed, it won't find me!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_129: Is that the wolf from the fairy tale? Is it bad?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_k_130: Dad, can I hand you the nails?
Will there be a corner for me? A little one?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_001: Made of glowstone? I want some in my kitchen.
Go up to the clouds, just wipe your boots after.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_002: An Allay! I wish it could take my washing in.
How it sings! I'd love it to sing my baby to sleep.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_003: We were dancing so happily! Why would you?
I set the whole table, and you ruined it all.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_004: I am packing a sack of bread. Just in case.
That red flicker is like a stove before a fire.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_005: Who disturbed the hive? Own up!
Ow! Right on my hand! Fetch me a cold rag!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_006: Oh, a little one! I will bring it fresh straw.
The mother looks so proud. I understand, I was the same.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_007: In my own kitchen? Get out of my house!
Not in front of the children! Somebody help!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_008: Oh, little one, go to the flowers, not my face.
Grow up big, I'll want honey for my pancakes.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_009: Kitten! Just stay out of my yarn basket.
I'll pour it some milk while my husband isn't looking.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_010: A chick! So the hen was sitting after all.
Oh, a yellow one. Keep the cat away from it.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_011: A calf! Soon there'll be milk for the whole street.
Go on, back to your mother, out from under my feet.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_012: Whose child is that, covered in weeds? Nobody's. Run!
Children, nobody goes near the well today!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_013: A foal! Legs as long as my son's.
Don't you gallop over my garden beds, little one.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_014: Dry as last year's flatbread, and it bites too.
Children, inside! That sandy one is no playmate.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_015: A little panda! It's about to sneeze, you'll see.
So round. I'd love to feed it something.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_016: The piglet's escaped the pen again. Catch it!
Clean for now. That won't last long.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_017: A lamb! Barely enough wool for one mitten.
Stay by your mother, little one, wolves are about.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_018: A wolf pup. Where there's a pup, there's a mother.
Don't touch it, children. Kind eyes, unkind teeth.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_019: Inside, quick! And bolt the door!
No mother would let one like that out at night.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_020: You little piglet! Drop that sword right now!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_021: Whose child is that? Oh, the poor thing's gone green.
Don't touch me, I've got my own little terrors at home!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_022: One look at you and my milk went sour.
Off you go, and take your curse with you.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_023: Oh, not in my hair, not in my hair!
Another bat got in. Close the windows at night!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_024: Little bee, go to my flowers, they're sweeter.
Where there's a bee, there's honey for pancakes.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_025: Lay it straight, I will be looking at it every day.
I brought water. Who is the most tired?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_026: My husband is hauling stones too. I will talk to him tonight.
That stone gives me shivers down my spine.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_027: I would have blocked just as well with a pot lid.
Bang on the shield! My dough just sank in the bowl.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_028: Oh, you woke the baby! Now you rock him yourself.
I nearly dropped my pot. Give a warning!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_029: A navy on dry land. My husband would approve.
At least my skirt stays dry, that's something.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_030: We're off! But who's holding the oar?
Ah, a breeze! Like on the pond when I was young.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_031: Can I have a cutting? I will plant it by the porch.
They glow at night? Then I can save on lamp oil.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_032: Breaking is easy. Who sweeps up the shavings?
Oh, a screw rolled to my porch. Come get it.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_033: Breaking is easy. Who's going to fix it?
Dust everywhere! I just washed the windows!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_034: Take the stone, but stay away from my hearth.
I could use a stone to weigh down my sauerkraut.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_035: Firewood? Bring it to me, I'll light the stove.
Was that the apple tree? My pies!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_036: How will I call the kids for supper now?
The bell's broken. Now I'll be late for market.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_037: Breaking is easy. Who's cleaning up?
Hey, that was a wall, not a door!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_038: I dusted that every single morning!
Now the neighbour will say our place looks bare.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_039: Now my husband will sit at home all day!
How will he earn our bread now?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_040: Smells like my soup when I forgot about it.
Could you brew something for a cough? Mine coughs all night.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_041: We do need a guard. My husband only snores loudly.
Put him by the nursery to guard the little ones.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_042: Fire! Water, bring water, my dress is burning!
Hot! Hot! Somebody roll me in a puddle!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_043: Ouch! Who planted that by my path?
Ow! Tore my apron, and my finger too!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_044: That hump must hold a week of water. Handy.
Keep it away from my washing, it chews everything.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_045: Where's the bell? How will I get the news?
The bell's gone and the neighbours didn't even notice.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_046: Who blocked my workstation? Own up.
Fine then, I'll go water the garden instead.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_047: I keep house, I don't run a stall.
I can't trade, but I can offer you a pie.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_048: Give me the flesh, it'll go in the porridge.
Don't throw out the seeds, I'll roast them.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_049: A cat in the house means no mice.
Sleeping on my pillow again? I can tell by the fur.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_050: Vanished into purple haze. Shall I warm your lunch?
Back from there? Wipe your feet, my floors are clean.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_051: You walk differently somehow. Feeling ill?
You're not yourself. I can tell a mile off.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_052: The wind's changed. That's no good sign.
The hens went quiet. Something's coming.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_053: Laying wherever again? Now I have to hunt for eggs.
Shoo from the garden! You'll peck up all my seedlings!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_054: I've been baking since dawn. Come in, take a pie!
The whole family's home today. The house is bursting!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_055: Still so much to bake, and nobody helps me.
Don't track snow in, I scrubbed the floors!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_056: Good, or the hens will get into the garden again.
Closed it? Check it, or the goats will wander off.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_057: Sleeping on the ground? Shall I bring you a blanket?
Dew falls at night. You will be soaked by morning, mark my words.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_058: I will tie my embroidered kerchief on it. For luck.
So beautiful. I am crying, and I chopped no onions today.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_059: Turn it over, or one side will burn!
Salt it a little. Everyone forgets the salt.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_060: A copper one walking. I'll polish it like my washbasin.
Gone all green. Needs vinegar, like my pots.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_061: Milking time, and she's off wandering again.
Leave the cow be, she's what feeds us.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_062: Creak, click, done. Could you make me a shelf?
Sweep up your shavings. I swept here yesterday.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_063: Children, come here! Don't look at the forest!
I'm not chopping that tree for firewood, leave it be.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_064: So cramped! There's nowhere to put my basket!
Neighbour, you're standing on my skirt!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_065: Oh, I'm rosy again! Where's my mirror?
How long was I gone? The house must be dusty!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_066: Ugh, now all my laundry will smell of diesel.
I baked pies, and it smells like I fried a forge.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_067: If only my children swam that nicely.
It's smiling at me. Kinder than the neighbours.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_068: My washing hangs on the left, so aim right.
Lower that bow, children run here, not rabbits.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_069: I treat colds with honey too. Proven.
Do not drip on your shirt, it never washes out.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_070: Drink up. My goat will give more.
It cures everything, I always said. Nobody listens.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_071: I just did my hair! You'll pay for this!
Soaked through! Now you dry my dress by the fire.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_072: Eat up, and then tell me the recipe.
You hold the spoon wrong, but your appetite is fine.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_073: Who eats standing up? Sit at a table properly.
Eat up, you've gone thin on those adventures.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_074: Pretty shimmer. I wish my pots were charmed against burning.
Those letters glow like a cat's eyes in the cellar.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_075: Grab the bread, everyone into the cellar!
I never told a bedtime story this scary.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_076: Every jar in my cellar just cracked.
The hens won't lay for a week now!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_077: Good, the sparks were flying onto the roof.
Oh, I wanted to roast potatoes on that.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_078: Good, wax doesn't grow on trees.
It's dark! Where will I find my needles now?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_079: Ow, my knees! I'm not a young girl anymore!
Ouch! Who left that hole uncovered?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_080: Ow! Whose anvil is this? I'll find him!
Ouch! Something heavy, and nobody even shouted!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_081: Do not overfeed, they get lazy, like my husband.
See, it nuzzles you. Animals sense kindness.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_082: I brought my last poker. Take it.
This forge is greedier than my boys.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_083: Since your bucket is full, water my garden on the way.
Do not slosh over the threshold, I just washed it.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_084: That one would fry nicely with an onion.
My husband says he catches ones this big. Liar.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_085: Click up, click down. If only my door worked like that.
Yanking it again? You're scaring my hens.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_086: I work the bellows, and my hands shake. Not a good sign.
Take the children away, sparks are flying!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_087: Brr! Where's my woolly shawl when I need it?
So cold... I should have stayed by the stove.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_088: Friday means bath day. The children will scream again.
Market tomorrow, and I haven't gathered the eggs.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_089: I salted the doorstep. Just in case.
No sewing today. My grandmother forbade it.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_090: Frogs by the well mean rain is coming.
Good, at least it eats the mosquitoes.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_091: I do not like this. I am taking the kids home.
Dark stone on the square? Ladies, have you lost your minds?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_092: I will give my ribbons, the brightest ones.
Hang the flags higher, so the goats do not chew them.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_093: I will bake pies, builders need feeding.
Children, out from underfoot, the stones are heavy!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_094: I do not mind the wool, I will shear more.
Under a pavilion we can sit and have a good chat.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_095: I will throw in my old basket too. It brought no luck.
The fire is blue, yet I am cold. Bad sign.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_096: I will light a candle too, for all of ours.
Tonight the children sleep with me. I feel calmer that way.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_097: I baked three pies and hid one more.
I will wear my festive shawl. Husband, comb your hair!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_098: I took out my black shawl. Have not worn it in ages.
I will bake memorial pies. Everyone come.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_099: A job! Finally, emeralds of my own!
Wait till my husband hears I'm working too!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_101: Oh, I've grown up! Where are my pigtails?
Mum, my dress is too small! I need a new one!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_102: The pumpkin goes in pies, the face goes on the porch.
I dressed the kids as zombies. Now they won't undress.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_103: Looks like my laundry blew away and started smiling.
Just don't let it hover over my garden. It blocks the sun.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_104: You old hag! I'll snap your broom!
Ow! That'll bruise half my arm!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_105: That was my carrot for the soup!
At least bring a basket, don't stuff your pockets.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_106: My husband planted those! Put them back!
Since you picked them, bring them here, I'll make soup.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_107: Oh, my little one, bald just like his father.
Right, nappies, cradle, and who gets to sleep now?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_108: Where are my kids? Has anyone seen my kids?
The cow won't give milk with all this noise.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_109: The bell! Something's happened again, I must find out.
It's ringing! Children, drop everything, home!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_110: Everyone to the cellar! I moved the pickles, there is room.
Where is my youngest? Has anyone seen my youngest?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_111: Air in a bottle? We have our own here, for free.
Come breathe in my garden instead, there is mint.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_112: Do not show the needle to the kids, they will cry.
I would give you linden honey, but you will not listen.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_113: Shiny, but it gives me neither use nor a pot.
To think smiths used to just make horseshoes.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_114: My husband once chased off a crow and bragged too.
Hang it over the fireplace, we will show the guests.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_115: Carry that like eggs, dear. Very gently.
Don't come near my stove with that thing!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_116: Leave a stain on my porch and you scrub it.
What is that smell? Like a smoking lamp.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_117: Oh, what a colour! Enough for a dress, I bet.
Do not drip it on your hands, a week to wash off.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_118: If you pass ruins, look for unbroken pots.
Take bread along. I will wrap some in a cloth.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_119: Does it say how to get a husband up early?
Read it to the kids at bedtime, I have told every tale.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_120: Can it find wild strawberries? That I would use.
Be back by night, I will set a candle in the window.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_121: You would do better reading a cookbook.
Do not read it aloud near the kids, they will never sleep.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_122: Heavy? It would make a fine weight for pickling.
Such a bluish shine. Enough for a pair of earrings.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_123: Is that my bucket? I water the cows with it.
Carry it away from my oven, I have bread in there.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_124: I would like a bread knife from that steel.
Good steel. Will you forge me a stove door?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_125: A pot strapped on? At least you can make soup on the road.
Packed wool socks? I could knit you some.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_126: Wash your hands after, hear me? With soap!
Do not carry that past my sauerkraut barrel.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_127: Yellow but not butter. Keep it out of my pantry.
I will tell the kids it is not cheese. A hundred times.
