[angry] Touch nothing you can't pay for.
I remember what you did. So do my prices.
Ah, a friend of the village! Let's see what I can do for you.
Good to see you! I put a few things aside, just in case.
You're always welcome here. Have a look.
Hmph. I'll trade, but I'm watching your hands.
Don't expect a smile. Expect a fair price. Mostly fair.
The village talks, you know. And it doesn't say nice things.
Wipe your feet before you come any closer.
Good day! Go on, have a look, nothing here bites.
A new face! Let's see if we can do business.
Everything's fresh this morning. Well, mostly.
It's been a quiet day. Let's change that.
Oh! Sorry, I was daydreaming. What can I get you?
Fair prices, fine weather. What more could you want?
Changed your mind? That's fine, I'll be here.
Hold on, why is the floor so far away now?
Yesterday I played tag. Today I have to pay for bread.
I'm a grown-up! Does that mean no more bedtime?
My voice went all deep. Hello? Hello!
[sigh] Childhood's over. Where do they hand out jobs around here?
Who's throwing medicine at people? It's the wrong kind!
My whole body just stung at once!
Ugh, my stomach... everything's going green.
Milk! Somebody bring me a bucket of milk!
[groaning] I feel awful. Did I eat something bad?
Hey! My legs feel like they're full of mud!
[angry] Who threw that? I'll catch you... eventually.
Everything is so... far... away... now.
My arms have gone all floppy, like boiled noodles!
[sigh] I couldn't lift a carrot right now.
What was in that bottle? My knees are giving way.
[singing] Carry me, river, gently far away.
I can't swim, just so you know.
Do I row, or do you?
Every Villager should own a Boat. I have decided.
A Boat is a fine place to sit and think.
Nice and calm. Just don't rock it.
A Boat! I've never left the shore before.
Look, a little Bee, no bigger than a berry!
Off to find your first flower, little one?
Shh, don't scare it. It's still learning to fly.
A kitten! Come here, I've got a bit of fish.
Look, it's pouncing on my sleeve!
Little furball! Who's a good little furball?
Chick, chick! Where's your mama, little one?
A little yellow puff on legs!
Yesterday an egg, today a chick. They grow up so fast.
Careful where you step, there's a chick underfoot!
[laughing] It's following me! I'm its mama now.
A calf! Look at those wobbly legs.
Moo to you too, little one.
One day you'll give milk. Today you just give cuddles.
A little one from the river, and even it wants to bite!
Who let that small Drowned out of the water?
Fellow Villagers! A soggy infant approaches!
A foal! All legs and no sense yet.
Look at it gallop! It'll be a fast one someday.
Hello, little horse. Will you give me a ride when you're grown?
A little Husk! Dry as old bread and twice as nasty!
[scared] It's small, but those teeth aren't!
Keep it away, just looking at it makes me thirsty!
A piglet! Look at that curly little tail!
It's found a puddle already. Of course it has.
It squeals like a rusty door hinge!
Come here, piggy, I've got a carrot for you.
A wolf pup! Will you guard my sheep one day?
Aww, it's so small. It hasn't learned crime yet.
Look at it chase its own tail!
[scared] A little Zombie! Lock the doors!
Don't let its size fool you, it bites like a big one!
It's running straight for my ankles!
That Skeleton has been lying in the swamp far too long.
Covered in moss and mushrooms. Doesn't anyone clean up after it?
[scared] Watch out, its arrows make you sick!
It smells like a damp cellar. Keep it away from me!
A swamp Skeleton! Get indoors, quick!
It's dripping all over the path. And it's aiming at me!
A Cat! Stay out of my fish basket, you!
Look at it stretch. That Cat has life all figured out.
Who's a soft one? You are!
Well, Cat, catch any mice today?
Got an Egg for me today?
Look at it peck. It never stops!
Shoo, shoo, out of the garden!
Chickens always look like they've forgotten something.
Careful, that one's the boss of the coop.
And where is this one off to in such a hurry?
Feathers everywhere! Who let it out of the pen?
A little copper fellow! Does it work for someone, or just wander?
[excited] It's sorting the chests! Can it come do mine?
It's going green at the edges. Somebody give it a good scrub.
Listen to it clink when it walks. Like a pocket full of coins.
A Copper Golem, here in our village! What an honour.
Careful, if it stands idle too long it turns into a statue.
There's a cow. I could use some fresh milk.
Easy there, big girl, nobody's after your grass.
[laughing] Look at her chew. Not a care in the world.
Cows always look like they know something we don't.
Who left the pasture gate open again?
A cow wandering about on her own. Somebody will be missing her.
Creeper! Everybody away from the houses!
No thank you. No explosions for me.
It's hissing! Why is it hissing?
Not near my garden, you green menace!
A Creeper! I only just rebuilt that wall!
Don't let it get close! It goes off like a barrel of powder!
[gasp] A Creeper, right behind you! Move!
What a mane! I wish my hair looked like that.
I bet that one could outrun the wind.
[gasp] Can I pat it? Will it kick?
Somebody fetch an apple, we have a guest!
A Horse in the village! Mind the vegetable patch.
Clip-clop, clip-clop. I love that sound.
Hey, Zombie, you look a bit... dry. You want some water?
It's a Husk! The sun doesn't even bother it!
That one brought half the desert with it.
[scared] Keep it away from me, it smells like a dried-up well!
Lock the doors! It's a Husk, and it's hungry.
Somebody tell it this isn't the desert. It won't listen, but still.
Is that a bear in black and white?
Mind the garden, little bear, that's not bamboo.
[laughing] Look, it rolled right over! Do it again!
Hello there, fluffy one. You've wandered far from the jungle.
A panda, here? Somebody fetch the children!
Hello, piggy. Keep out of the carrots.
That pig looks happier than I do.
A pig! Who left the pen open again?
Hello, Sheep. Lovely day for standing around, eh?
A fluffy cloud with legs, that's what you are.
Chew the grass all you like, but leave my flowers alone!
White, black, grey... who picks a Sheep's color?
That's a fine fleece. The Shepherd will be pleased.
Is it lost? Somebody take it back to the pen.
Look at it stare. Do I have grass on my face?
Sheep are so calm. I want to be a Sheep.
Don't follow me, I haven't got any Wheat!
Rattle all you want, you're not coming in!
Stay in the sun, Skeleton. Please, just stay in the sun.
Hide behind the wall! Arrows can't go through stone.
Where's a Wolf when you need one?
A Snow Golem! Somebody built a friend out of winter.
Can it talk? Hello! ...No? Just snowballs, then.
Good work, snowman. Keep pelting those monsters for us.
It leaves a trail of snow wherever it goes. Who's sweeping that up?
Is it cold inside you all the time? Poor thing.
Stay out of the desert, friend. The sun there would melt you in a moment.
A Stray! Its arrows turn your legs to jelly.
It came down from the frozen hills. Lock the doors!
[scared] I can hear its bones rattling in the wind.
Don't stand out in the open. It won't miss for long.
Ugh, it smells of snow and old graves.
Somebody tell the Golem we've got a frosty guest!
Don't chew my boots, little one.
Who's a brave little pup? You are!
It tripped over its own tail. [laughing] Adorable.
Does he bite? He doesn't bite, does he?
Keep him away from my sheep, please.
He's wagging! I think he likes me.
A wolf at your side and not a trace of fear. Brave.
Can I pet him? Just once?
My grandfather had a dog like that. Best hunter around.
With a wolf like that, no zombie will dare come near you.
A Witch! Don't drink anything she offers you.
Hear that cackle? Nothing good ever follows a laugh like that.
She's brewing something in the bushes. I can smell it from here.
[whisper] Keep the children indoors until she's gone.
Purple robes and a pointy hat. That's no cleric!
Shoo! Go stir your pot somewhere else!
A Witch at the edge of the village! Somebody fetch the Golem.
Hear that groaning? That's not my neighbour snoring.
It's shuffling this way. Somebody shut the door!
Wait for sunrise, it'll burn. Just hold the door till then.
Don't let it near the children!
I'll throw a potato at it. [nervous laugh] It's all I've got.
[scared] Who poked the hive? Own up!
Don't swat at it, you'll only make it worse!
Into the house, everyone, shut the door!
It's buzzing at me like I owe it honey!
[whisper] Eyes on your boots. Just look at your boots.
He's carrying off a piece of our road! Put that back!
An Enderman, here? Keep walking and don't turn around.
It keeps vanishing and popping up somewhere else. Makes my head spin.
Thank you for keeping watch, big friend.
With the Golem around, I sleep like a baby.
[laughing] Careful where you step, there are flowers there!
Look at those arms! Nothing gets past him.
Here, I picked you a poppy for a change.
Does it ever rust in the rain, I wonder?
On your rounds again? You never take a day off.
A lamb! Like a little white pillow.
Look, it's hopping! Lambs always hop.
Grow your wool nice and thick, little one, I need a new blanket.
It's like sand, only brighter. Don't get it in your boots.
Ugh, dust everywhere. Who's going to sweep it up?
Dig under it and it slides down like sand. Mind your head.
Dirt? We've got plenty of that already, thanks.
Good soil! Plant some potatoes in it.
[sigh] And I've only just swept the path.
That's redstone business. I'll stand a little further away.
My grandfather tinkered with that once. We still don't talk about the barn.
Does it bake bread? No? Then what's it for?
Snow, carried here by hand? Now I've seen everything.
Pile it up by the gate and the kids will have a fort by noon.
The shovel's in my shed, if you need to clear it later.
Mind you, it melts by a torch. Keep it away from the lamps.
Wool! Soft enough to sleep on.
That colour would make a lovely blanket.
Walls of wool? I bet it's quiet as a pillow in there.
My grandmother would knit three scarves out of that.
[laughing] Careful, the cat will claim it.
Did the shepherd sell you that? He drives a hard bargain.
Ow! A Vex! It flies right through the walls!
Get it off me! The little flying thing has a sword!
[scared] Where did it come from? It came out of the ceiling!
[scared] Help! He swings that axe like he's paid for it!
Ow! That went right through my shirt!
Grey face, mean eyes, big axe. I knew he wasn't here to trade!
My skin is fizzing! What did she put in that?
Ugh, it's sticky and it smells like a swamp.
Ow! Am I turning purple? I'm turning purple, aren't I?
My best shirt! That stain will never come out.
[coughing] Stop splashing me! I don't want any of your brews!
[scared] It charged straight into me! Those tusks are huge!
Ow! Rotten, furious and full of tusks. What kind of beast is that?
Get it off me! It smells worse than the compost!
[scared] Teeth coming out of the ground! Jump!
Ow! That fellow in the robe made the dirt bite me!
An Evoker! Somebody stop his spells!
Fresh off the grindstone! Sharp enough to split a hair!
An axe for the woods, a sword for the night. Take both!
Every blade balanced by hand. Feel the weight!
This blade, will cut. This blade will kiiill.
Zombies at the door? You'll want something sharper than a spoon.
Don't touch the edge! [sigh] Too late. Bandages are by the door.
[excited] I'm here! Did I miss anything?
Ooh, the world is so big and bright!
Who are all these people looking at me?
[laughing] You can't catch me! I'm the fastest in the village!
Wait for me! No fair, you started early!
Round the well and back! Go!
I had a really scary dream. Was it a dream?
I want my mum! Where's my mum?
A name! A real one! Say it again!
Hmm... I'll wear it for a day and see how it fits.
Wait, how do you spell it?
Mum! Dad! I've got a name now!
Now everyone has to call me that. Even the chickens.
It's so red! Will my teeth go red too?
Beetroot... Do I have to eat all of it?
Mum says beetroot makes you strong. Okay, one bite.
I'll share it with my friends! Maybe.
[excited] A whole loaf, just for me?
Grandpa says carrots help you see in the dark!
Can I give half to the horse? Horses love these.
Crunch! Did you hear how loud that was?
A potato! Can we bake it in the fire?
It's all lumpy. I like lumpy ones.
I'm going to plant it and grow a hundred more!
[excited] The bell! Can I ring it next?
[excited] Dragon! I'm going to breathe fire! Well, maybe later.
Roar! Everybody run, the Dragon is here!
Last one to the well is a rotten egg!
Huh? Who turned the sky off?
It's dark! I want to go home to mama.
But I haven't even had lunch yet!
[scared] Are the monsters coming out now?
Was I asleep? I don't remember sleeping!
The sun just ran across the sky!
Thanks! I was so hungry my tummy was talking.
Is it all for me? I'll share. Maybe.
It's like the stars came down to play!
[excited] Was that red? It was red AND blue!
I want one as big as the whole sky!
Hi! Do you want to play tag?
[gasp] You're really tall! How old are you?
Mum says not to talk to strangers. Are you a stranger?
What's in your pockets? Anything sweet?
I saw what you did. I'm watching you!
[scared] Don't come closer, or I'll call the Golem!
You're mean. I'm not playing with you.
Can I climb on you? Just a little bit?
How did you get so big? Did you eat all your vegetables?
You smell like rain and rust.
If a monster comes, you'll chase it away, right? Promise?
Can you toss me up high, like you toss Zombies?
[whisper] Hi, Golem. Do you ever sleep?
Your arms are longer than all of me!
When I grow up, I want to be just like you!
Everybody look! It's the one who chased the raiders off!
Can I hold your sword? Just for a second?
[cheering] The hero's here! The hero's here!
Were you scared? I bet you weren't scared.
I drew you on the wall. Mom wasn't happy.
That's not how you play! You're mean!
I don't have anything to sell! Just a pebble. You can't have the pebble.
[laughing] I'm too little for trading! Ask my mum.
Are you trying to buy me? I'm not for sale!
When I grow up I'll have a shop. A big one! Come back then.
No grown-up stuff with me! I'm busy playing.
Why are you poking me? I'm not a counter!
I counted my coins. I have none. That's not enough, right?
[whisper] Night roads are no place to be seen. So I'm not.
A trader no one can see can't be robbed. Clever, no?
Careful where you step, my toes are right there.
Strange to look down and find no feet. I'll get used to it.
Sometimes I forget I drank it and wave at people. Nobody waves back.
I always keep one of my own potions for myself. Wise, yes?
Ask for anything! You'll just have to guess where to look.
Mind your manners. Invisible ears hear everything.
Best part of being unseen? Nobody haggles with thin air.
Pretend you can't see me. Wait. You can't? Ahh, excellent.
[whisper] Hush, my Llamas. Pretend you're out for a walk on your own.
Two Llamas strolling about with nobody holding them. Yes, perfectly normal.
One sip and I'm gone. Llama, you'll have to pretend you're wild.
Time for me to disappear. Trade secrets, you understand.
A little sip for the road.
[laughing] Now you see me, and now you don't!
If anyone asks, I was never in this village.
The road is safer when nobody can see you on it.
Well met, friend! Come see what the road brought me.
Don't be shy. My Llamas only spit at folk who don't buy.
Seeds from the jungle, shells from the coast. Take a look!
I'm only here a little while. Buy before I'm gone.
A traveller! I can tell you're missing a rare flower.
[sigh] My feet ache, but my packs are full. Buy something?
Fair prices, friend. Fair-ish. Mostly fair.
Every road leads somewhere, and today it led me to you.
Fresh goods from three lands away! Mostly fresh.
[humming] Over the hills and on to the next village.
Rare goods, honest prices. Well, one of those is true.
Nobody around. Fine, I'll haggle with the Llamas.
A new sunrise, a new road. That's the life for me.
My boots have walked further than most villagers ever will.
Emeralds in, Emeralds out. My purse never gets any heavier.
Pack the blankets, count the potions, off we go.
The left Llama spits at customers. I'm still training the right one.
Every village asks for a discount. Every village gets the same answer.
I sleep under the stars. Mostly because inns charge Emeralds.
Is there a village over that hill? There's always a village over the next hill.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.wrjbdds: Come here, quick. You won't believe what that stranger has been up to.
Morning rounds! Fences: standing. Well: wet. Villagers: mostly cheerful.
Good work, everyone. I'll mention it in my next speech.
The treasury is fine. I counted it twice. The second time I got a different number.
A mayor must hear out every villager. Even the one who only talks about potatoes.
Note to self: more benches by the bell. People like to sit.
That road needs lanterns. I'll put it on the list. The list is getting long.
Nice to see the village growing. Every new roof is a little victory.
Ow! Is this how you treat your elected leader?
[angry] Attacking the mayor! I'll bring this up at the next meeting.
Guards! Golem! Anyone! The mayor is under attack!
Ouch. That's it, a new village rule: no hitting the mayor.
Careful! Who'll run this village if I'm laid up for a week?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.wrjbddt: [gasp] With a pickaxe? In broad daylight?!
Morning already? I didn't even finish my dream!
Mama says nights are long. That one wasn't!
Yay, it's day! Can I go and play now?
The sun jumped up so fast! Did you see?
Hey! I was just about to walk through!
[angry] How rude! Open it back up.
Fine, I'll just stand here and wait. Again.
Off my bed! I only made it this morning!
Boots on the blanket? Were you raised in a cave?
Rain again! And my washing's still on the line.
Good for the crops, bad for my shoes.
I should have stayed in bed today.
Rain down my collar! Brr, that's cold.
Drip, drip, right on top of my head. Of course.
Snow up to my knees. Who ordered this much?
Crunch, crunch. At least it's a nice sound.
I left footprints! Now everyone knows where I've been.
My toes went numb a while ago.
Hello down there! [whisper] Please, nobody answer.
I haven't seen the sky in ages. I miss it already.
So much stone over my head. I hope it's well stuck together.
I can't even see my own feet down here.
[scared] Something is dripping. Or breathing. I'd rather it was dripping.
Don't look down. [nervous laugh] I looked down.
The whole village looks like a little toy from up here.
My ears are popping. Is this how birds feel all the time?
Brr! My breath is making little clouds.
I should have brought a second coat. And a third.
[gasp] Who's there? Is it morning? It's not morning!
I'd only just got the blanket right, and you've ruined it.
[sigh] I start work at dawn, you know.
Whatever it is, tell the chickens. They get up early.
[angry] Out of my bedroom! I'm in my nightshirt!
Hmm. I'd have put it a bit to the left.
One block at a time, that's how villages grow.
You carry all those blocks in your pockets? My back hurts just thinking about it.
If that's a wall, it's a very short one.
You're building here, in the End? Brave. Or a little silly.
Everything out here is so quiet and purple. I miss the grass.
Careful near the edge, there's nothing under it at all.
Click! Did a door open somewhere?
My grandfather said never press a button you didn't put there yourself.
Do it again! I want to see what happens.
Nothing happened. Or something happened very far away.
[nervous laugh] Please tell me that wasn't the dynamite.
Nothing beats a fire on a cool evening.
Keep your sleeves away from those flames.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.wrswgis: Shh, gather round. This one's about a villager who walked past the last fence and kept going...
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.wrswgib: He walked until his boots wore thin. Then, on a lonely road, two shaggy dogs taller than a horse crept up behind him.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.wrswgit: [upset] Don't tell me they caught him!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.wrswgic: Enough! I won't sleep a wink tonight!
Pffff, I can fly too! [straining] Nnngh! I can't do it when you're watching.
Come down, you'll frighten the chickens.
You can see the whole village from up there. Is my roof all right?
Are you a bird? You don't look like a bird.
My neck hurts from looking up at you.
What if you fall? Who's going to catch you?
Don't fly off without saying goodbye!
Is that some kind of spell? Teach me!
Hanging in the air like a lantern. It's unsettling.
Click! And what did that just open?
Careful, last time someone pulled a lever, the well flooded.
Is that the lever for the farm gate? Or the lamps?
Click, clack, click. Make up your mind!
[gasp] Where are you taking that poor animal?
Lead it gently, it's not used to strangers.
If that one's going in a pen, ask the shepherd first.
Hello? Did you fall asleep standing up?
Stand there much longer and I'll start hanging my laundry on you.
I think they're a statue now. We must build a shrine!
What if they're watching us? Like, WATCHING US but pretending not to.
[gasp] Since when does the ground fall from above?
Somebody look at that cliff. It's coming apart.
Thump! My heart nearly jumped out.
From now on I walk under roofs. Solid ones.
Everyone away from the tall trees!
Somebody check that nothing's on fire!
Leave me alone, lightning! I don't want to be a Witch!
Hey! I sleep there! Where am I supposed to sleep now?
[sad] My Bed! I'd only just plumped the pillow.
Tonight I sleep on the floor. Thanks to you.
Who breaks somebody's Bed? Put it back right now!
[gasp] The Bell! How will we know when to gather now?
Without the Bell, who'll warn us when raiders come?
Hey! That was there to look pretty!
[sigh] It took me ages to get that just right.
Leave the pretty things alone! The village looks bare without them.
My Door! Now any Zombie can stroll right in!
There was a perfectly good handle, you know.
[angry] I'm not paying for a new Door. You are!
Slow down! You'll dig through the whole hill!
Are you looking for something down there?
[whisper] Look at it go. A mole with a pickaxe, I swear.
At this rate there won't be any ground left to stand on.
Good stone, that. Save some for our walls.
Leave the trees by the houses, they give us shade.
Plant a sapling for every tree you take, all right?
[sniff] Ah, fresh-cut wood. Smells like a new house.
[gasp] My workplace! Where am I supposed to work now?
Hey! It took me a whole day to set that up!
And what will I trade now? Air?
You'd better have a spare one in your pocket.
[scared] Did the night just get darker, or is it me?
Everyone lock your doors. Things just got serious.
Now the Zombies will break down doors. Wonderful.
I hope you know what you're doing, because I don't.
The monsters are gone? Just like that?
[sigh] Finally, a night walk without looking over my shoulder.
Quiet nights at last. The Golem will be bored to rust.
You're floating! Is that even allowed?
Blocks out of thin air? That's not how we built our houses.
Strange. The whole world just felt a little different.
Somewhere far away, a Zombie just changed its mind.
[sad] No coming back this time. I'll miss you.
We'll name a street after you. A short one, but still.
I'll keep your favourite trade open, just in case.
All those days, all those trades... and now just quiet.
Who's going to chase the zombies off now?
[gasp] You're soaring like a Phantom! A friendly one, I hope.
Take me with you next time!
Careful when you land! Mind the roofs!
From up there the village must look like a toy.
They say wings like those come from the End. Is it true?
There you go, right over the bell!
Solid iron. Reliable. A bit like wearing a bucket, though.
Iron's fine for zombies. For anything worse, you'll want diamonds.
Only half dressed for battle? Is the rest still at the blacksmith's?
Off to fight something? Try not to bring it back here.
Is that diamond? I can see my face in your chestplate!
[gasp] Where did you find all that? Show me the mine!
Stand still, I want to remember what real armour looks like.
Iron helmet, gold boots... Did you raid three different chests?
Nothing matches, but I suppose it all works.
[laughing] You look like a scarecrow made of leftovers.
You've got a dark cloud following you, stranger.
[scared] That look in your eyes... Pillagers will follow you here!
Don't bring that trouble near my house!
Your face has gone all shadowy. Are you well?
[worried] You're squinting at nothing. Take my hand, I'll lead you.
Something deep below put that shadow on you. I'd stay away from there.
You look like you could eat a whole haystack.
Here, sit down, I'll find you some bread.
When did you last eat? You've gone all grey.
Who just walked past me? I heard footsteps!
[scared] The grass is moving all by itself!
I can see your boots walking around on their own!
If you're a spook, go and haunt the neighbours instead.
[gasp] You're hurt! Sit down this minute!
You look terrible. Go and lie down for a while.
Shall I fetch the Cleric? You look like you need one.
You're glowing, sparkling and swirling all at once!
How many potions did you drink this morning?
[nervous laugh] Are all those bubbles around you safe?
You're swaying like a boat in a storm. Sit down a moment.
If you're going to be sick, the composter is over there.
You've gone a funny colour, and not a good one.
Your eyes are shining like a cat's. It's a little spooky.
You can see in the dark? Then help me find my lost hoe.
With eyes like that, you'd never need a torch again.
[gasp] You're dripping slime everywhere! Not on my doorstep, please.
Is that slime? Did you hug a Slime?
If you fall over, don't be surprised when Slimes pop out of you.
Heavy feet today? Mine get like that after harvest.
A Turtle could pass you. A sleepy one.
Do you need a hand? Or should I bring a cart?
You could carry a whole haystack by yourself now.
Gently with the door, you'll pull the handle clean off.
[laughing] Help me with my firewood while you're like that?
Whoa! You whooshed past and the hens scattered!
Where's the fire? Slow down a bit!
If you're running errands, take mine too!
[gasp] One moment they're here, the next it's just their things on the ground!
Should I pick up their things? No, that would be rude.
Will they come back? They usually come back.
[sad] Poor thing. Nobody should go like that.
I'll tell the mayor. He keeps a list of these things.
Quick, somebody remember where it happened!
[sigh] And such a good customer, too.
I didn't see a thing. I was watching a chicken.
I hope their bed is close. It's a long walk back.
Well, that's one way to leave a conversation.
[laughing] Sorry! Sorry. I laugh when I'm nervous.
Hmmm, I think you might just be bad at the game.
Again? I haven't finished being sad about the first time!
[sigh] I'm going to need a separate list just for you.
Maybe eat some bread and have a little rest first?
I'm going to light this, if you don't stop me!... I will! I'll do it!... Don't test me! ... Oh, never mind.
Red and white and nothing good. Who left this here?
[scared] Nobody bring a torch anywhere near that!
Morning already? I'll lie here one more minute. Two, at most.
My back says I slept on a potato. I didn't. I checked.
[yawning] Good morning, ceiling. Good morning, window.
I dreamt I sold a whole cart of melons. Best trade I never made.
Up, up. The fields won't weed themselves.
Oof, my knees woke up before the rest of me did.
I dreamed a Cow was chasing me and now I'm scared. And also awake.
Breakfast first, then work, then a nap. A good plan.
[angry] I watered those every single morning!
Put that down! I counted every sprout.
All those days of weeding, and you just yank them out?
Careful! You almost knocked my lunch out of my hands.
There's a whole village to walk around in, you know.
Whoa! I nearly fell into the flower bed!
Easy there, I'm not a door.
Shove me again and I'm telling the Golem.
Go around, please. I'm not moving.
Hey! I was standing here first.
Are you in a hurry, or just clumsy?
My grandmother walked straighter than you, and she had a cane.
Why do you keep bumping into me? Do you like me or something?
Light straight into the sky! They must see it from the other end of the world.
Lost travellers will find their way to us by that light.
What does it do, besides look wonderful?
[impressed] That must have taken a lot of iron.
I'm going to sit by it every evening.
[yawning] Just looking at it makes me sleepy.
Not too close to my house, please. I snore.
A whole shelf of books! The librarian will want to move in with you.
I only look at the pictures, but I love the smell of books.
Put up a few more and you can enchant things, I hear.
Have you read all of them? Even the dull ones?
Ah, a workbench. Making something useful, I hope.
You carry a workbench around with you? Handy.
Make me a little stool while you're at it.
My grandfather made his from a single log. Sturdy thing.
A grinning pumpkin! Is there a feast tonight?
That face is watching me. I don't like it.
Better than a torch, and it smiles too.
Music! Play something we can dance to.
Not too loud, the baby's sleeping.
If it plays anything sad, I'm going home.
A lever. Pull it and something happens somewhere, right?
Slept in your armour again? You must have clanked all night.
Doesn't the chestplate dig into your ribs when you sleep?
[laughing] Sleeping in boots! My grandmother would be horrified.
Bricks keep the heat in. Better than my old plank walls.
Proper bricks! Someone spent days baking those.
Building a chimney? The smoke always blows into my window.
Lay them straight, now. Crooked bricks make a crooked house.
Shiny now, but give it a few rains.
Wax it, or it'll turn the colour of moss.
[gasp] That's nine emeralds sitting in one spot!
You don't build with that, you trade with it! Oh, my poor heart.
If the mayor sees that, he'll want it for the town hall.
That stone is from the End? It looks so... lonely.
Pale and cold. Something tells me you went very far for that.
I ate a piece of that once. It tasted nothing like cheese. Very disappointing.
A window! Now I can see who's knocking before I open up.
The children will have it smudged within a day.
If a bird flies into that, it's not my fault.
Put that in the cellar, it'll keep the fish fresh.
My boots and ice are not friends.
Is that for sliding? Can the kids have a go?
Ice, here? Did you carry it all the way down from the mountains?
[laughing] Let's watch the next person try to walk across that.
Look at all that iron! The smith would weep with joy.
[excited] Are you making a Golem? We could use one!
[gasp] That blue! My wife hasn't got a dress half that colour.
The enchanter will want that. He talks about lapis all day long.
Careful, the whole street will look like a pond.
Light from nowhere? No lamp, no torch... nothing!
Strange. I can't see a thing there, but it shines.
Now I can walk home at night without falling into the well.
Two of you? Now I have to remember two faces.
Is this a meeting? Nobody told me there was a meeting.
Travelling in a group? Smart. It's safer at night.
Eating on the go? Sit down, you'll get a stomach ache.
Chew properly, nobody's going to take it from you.
Now I'm hungry too. Thanks a lot.
Save me the crust, would you?
Did anyone say you could pick those?
[sigh] And who's going to replant that, hm?
Hey! The garden isn't a shop counter!
That patch belongs to somebody, you know.
Could you not? I don't like loud sounds.
Snip, snip! I hope you left it some for the cold nights.
Gently! It's a Sheep, not a bush!
Look at all that Wool. Someone's getting a new Bed.
Purple stone? I've never seen a quarry that colour.
It looks like it was carved out of a giant flower.
That's from the End cities, isn't it? They say they hang over nothing.
[gasp] You were over there! Now you're here!
Did you just throw yourself? With a green marble?
Warn a fellow next time. My poor heart!
Hm, saves on walking, I suppose. Doesn't it hurt?
If you can do that, why do you ever bother with doors?
Morning! The chickens beat you by an hour.
Sleep well? You snore like a ravager, you know.
Up already? The bread's still warm, help yourself.
Look at that sunrise! Good morning for getting up.
Out like a candle all night? Lucky. The zombies kept me awake.
Go wash your face, the well's just over there.
New day, new trades. Shall we?
Good timber! That'll make a fine table.
Smells like fresh sap. I love that smell.
Building a fence? Ours keeps falling over, if you have any left.
A sign! I'll paint my name on it and hang it by my door.
What shall I write on it? 'Knock first', maybe.
Hold on, which way up does it go?
For me? Does it suit me? Tell me honestly.
Oh, how fancy! I'll wear it to the next festival.
Someone dropped half their house here.
That's a job for the lost and found.
What a mess. Who's going to sweep all this up?
Is there a wedding nobody told me about?
Look at that sparkle! Better than any star.
Whoosh, crack, and every color at once!
[nervous laugh] Lovely. Now my hands are shaking.
Point it up, not at the houses, please!
[gasp] The horror! The XP, it's EVERYWHERE!
Little green lights! Are they bugs? Don't bite me!
They're following you around like ducklings.
Pretty, but I don't trust anything that glows.
Where do these even come from? Does the ground cough them up?
That tree wasn't standing there a moment ago.
[whisper] Something in those branches is watching us.
A Creaking! Do not look away, do not look away!
[nervous laugh] Hear that creak? Tell me it's just the wind.
That frog just snapped a fly right out of the air!
[laughing] Look how far it hops, and it's such a tiny thing!
Frogs mean the swamp is healthy. My grandmother always said so.
An orange one! They say the colour depends on where it grew up.
Is that one giving the other a ride? Why?
[scared] Two monsters for the price of one!
Even the monsters ride now. That's not fair!
Who taught it to ride? Somebody, please, make it forget!
No cookies for you, little friend! Seeds only.
It's dancing! Is there music playing somewhere?
So many colours on one small bird!
Careful, it repeats what it hears. Say nothing rude.
A parrot! Has it flown all the way from the jungle?
Something big is flapping up there. Everyone indoors!
Don't look up, don't look up, don't look up.
Its wings are torn like an old sail, and still it flies.
Shoo, little one! Stay out of my carrot patch!
Look at those ears twitch. It hears everything.
If you catch it, the butcher will make a stew. I'd rather you didn't.
[whisper] Don't move. Let's see if it comes closer.
A Turtle! Take your time, friend, nobody rushes in this village.
[excited] Look how slow it is! That's one race I could win!
Don't step on the eggs on the beach! Turtles never forgive that.
It carries its house on its back. No roof to patch, no neighbours. Clever.
Hello, little shell! Did you get lost on the way to the sea?
Which one of the glowy dots are your eyes?
[whisper] It's listening for us. Breathe quietly.
[scared] The ground shakes when that thing walks. Back away slowly.
There! A Warden! I shall stand perfectly still and also scream internally.
Did you do this? Did you summon that thing? Why?
[screaming] Black skulls flying everywhere! Everyone into the cellars!
Everything it touches withers and rots. Get away from it!
[sad] My garden! It's flattening my whole garden!
Easy now, big fellow. I've got no fish, I promise.
Don't go near its cub, the mother gets very cross.
White as fresh snow. How does it keep so clean?
[nervous laugh] Nice bear. Nice, big, very toothy bear.
It's chewing on the fence! Shoo, shoo!
Keep it away from the bread. Everything it touches smells funny after.
If we feed it ice, will it slide away forever? Let us find out!
Look how it bounces! Like a big yellow jelly.
Is it alive, or is it a block? I can't decide.
[angry] Who threw that? I saw you!
I'm too old for snowball fights, you know!
Wow, you're really good at this staring contest!
Who left a knight standing here? Oh, it's empty inside.
Hang some armour on it and it'll scare crows better than a scarecrow.
[gasp] Run! The Golem's angry with you!
I wouldn't stand there if I were you.
What did you do to make him that cross?
[sad] No... we were just talking this morning.
Who's going to tell the family?
I'll ring the bell for them tonight.
Good day, Mayor! Lovely weather for a speech.
Mayor! About that hole in the road...
[whisper] Stand up straight, the Mayor's coming.
Mayor, could the treasury spare a coin for my fence?
Use it well! By morning I'll be over the next hill.
Off I go again. My Llamas are getting restless.
Remember my face. I'll be back with even stranger goods!
A good trade. The road is kind to generous folk.
Looking is free, leaving is even cheaper. I see you chose cheap.
[sigh] I'll pack it all up again, then.
You'll regret this when I'm three villages away.
Prices like these, you'll never see again!
Fine, fine. I'll find someone with better taste.
Rain or shine, the road goes on.
My Llamas hate the rain. They spit even more.
I've slept under worse skies than this. Much worse.
A buyer! Come closer, my llamas don't bite. Usually.
Ah! I have many wonderful things, acquired from very far away places that I have definitely been to!
Look, choose, pay. The road is long and my feet are tired.
Special prices, today only! Tomorrow I'll be gone anyway.
That came from beyond the mountains, you know.
Sold! One less thing for my Llamas to carry.
Splendid. Every Emerald goes to the village treasury.
Huh huh! You drive a hard bargain, but I respect that. Well met!
Good. Now, if you'll excuse me, the roads won't plan themselves.
Do come again. A mayor likes a familiar face.
All done. Off you go, and mind the flower beds.
Leaving already? I had a speech prepared!
[sigh] And I thought we were becoming friends.
My door is always open. My patience, less so.
Very well. I'll note it in the town chronicle.
A mayor's offer comes only once, you know. Well, twice. Come back tomorrow.
You strike the head of this village? Have you no shame?
Ow! There will be a fine for this, and a big one!
Stop! Guards! Golem! Anyone who works for me!
Owww! I'm calling a town meeting about this! Everyone's gonna hear about what you did!
I sign every paper in this village, and I'll sign the one that sends you away!
Ah, a visitor! Welcome to our village. Mind the flowerbeds.
Ah. You. Hello. Uh, you saw me doing nothing.
Good to see you. The village could use a helping hand.
Gasp! You recognise me! Obviously. I'm very recognisable.
If you need anything, it's on the notice board. If it isn't, ask me.
Interesting timing. I don't suppose you're the type to keep quiet about things?
Welcome! Our roads are new, our bread is fresh, and our mayor is me.
Stay as long as you like. Just don't dig under the town hall.
[sigh] Wages, roads, weddings... Oh, hello! I didn't see you there.
Every new face is good for the village. Usually. Behave yourself.
Huh? Where did my old life go? Did I even have one?
Hello, neighbours! Mind if I stay a while?
I feel like I've just walked in from nowhere.
Do I have a name yet? I'd like a nice one.
Strange, I already know how much bread costs.
[gasp] Grass! Sky! Oh, I like it here.
Right, first things first. Where's a bed and where's work?
I don't remember being born, but I'm glad I was.
Smells like hay and fresh bread. Must be a village.
You! You're the first thing I ever saw. Hello, you.
My legs work, my hands work. A fine start to a life.
Is it morning? It feels like the very first morning.
Snow on the roofs and soup on the stove. December is kind.
The year is almost spent. I'll count my Emeralds and sigh.
Warm wishes to you and yours this winter!
I'm knitting socks for the whole family. I'm on the first sock.
October is the time when fellow villagers tell scary tales by the fire!
The nights are getting longer. More time to check the door bolt twice.
Pumpkin soup, pumpkin pie, pumpkin bread. I may turn orange.
The leaves are falling, fellow citizen! What a wonderful month!
[whisper] Don't tell anyone, but I sleep with a lantern lit all October.
Cold mornings, warm milk, a blanket on my knees. October, I've missed you.
Monday. My hoe got heavier since Sunday somehow.
[sigh] A whole week ahead, and I've already lost my gloves.
Who decided weeks should start with Monday? I'd like a word with them.
Mondays are for soup. Something has to make them bearable.
Saturday. The square will be busy by noon, you watch.
I'll walk to the far field and back. No reason. It's Saturday.
Saturday! Bath day. Not that I've had one yet.
Sunday brings a strange calm to the village. Even the livestock seem quieter.
Sunday. I'm doing nothing, and I'm doing it with care.
Tomorrow it's work again. Today I'm counting clouds.
Thursday. I've nearly remembered what I planned to do on Monday.
Thursday. A perfectly acceptable day for ambling about with no purpose whatsoever.
Thursday already, and the fence still isn't painted.
Thursdays smell of fresh bread. Or maybe that's just the baker.
Tuesday. Not as bad as Monday, and that's all I'll say for it.
On Tuesdays I mend things. Today it's my left boot.
Wednesday. Half the week behind me, half the soup still in the pot.
Wednesday wandering. Could be anywhere by Thursday, probably.
Hump day, they call it. I call it... Wednesday.
Weekend! The sheep don't know it, but I do.
Two whole days without a single trade. Bliss.
Weekends I visit my cousin across the river. He never visits me.
I swapped the signs on every door. Good luck finding your house! April Fools!
The well has run dry! [laughing] No it hasn't. Got you.
Ha ha, made you look, it was only a chicken.
Your shoelace is undone! [laughing] You don't even have shoelaces.
I told the farmer his wheat turned blue. He's still out there staring at it.
Last night of the year! I'm staying up, I promise. Mostly.
Next year I'll finally fix the roof. I said that last year too.
Who's bringing the cake tonight? I'll bring a spoon.
Goodbye, old year. You were mostly fine.
[excited] Fireworks at midnight! I'll stand well back this time.
So pretty. The whole room glows.
Careful with that flame near the bookshelves.
Close it behind you, please. The zombies don't need an invitation.
Ah, a creaky door. I keep meaning to oil that.
Good, shut it. The sheep keep getting out.
Shut it behind you, or the sheep will go for a walk.
Out so late? Mind the monsters.
Sleep well when you get home.
I'd be in bed by now, but I keep hearing Zombies outside.
The moon is up. Decent folk are in bed by now.
Look at all those stars. Pity I'm too scared to stay out.
Afternoon! The sun's lovely and warm today.
Half the day gone already, and I've done nothing. Perfect.
Good afternoon. Have you eaten yet?
Ah, a fine afternoon for a little nap in the shade.
Evening already. Where did the day go?
The sky's turning pink. Best time of day.
Evening, friend. Supper will be on the table soon.
Work's done for today. Time to put my feet up.
Don't stay out too late, the dark brings trouble.
Morning! Did the sun wake you too?
Up already? The bread's still warm.
[sigh] Morning. Five more minutes would have been nice.
Lovely morning for work, isn't it?
Ooh, give it a happy face this time!
Careful with those shears, mind your fingers!
Ah, now it feels cosy around here.
Who's got something to roast? I'll bring the potatoes!
A whole bucket for one little candle? A puff would have done.
Bubbling bottles... I sniffed one once and heard colours for an hour.
Brewing something? Is that the one that makes you run fast? Asking for my legs.
It makes things while nobody's looking? I'd like one for my chores.
[suspicious] A box that clicks and crafts all on its own... I'm keeping an eye on it.
Don't point that thing at me! I've seen what it does with arrows.
Load it up and give it a spark. Just make sure you're standing behind it.
It hands out one thing at a time. Very polite, for a box.
Is that the box that drops things, or the one that throws them? I always mix them up.
What's baking? Oh, ore. Shame, I was hoping for bread.
Don't forget to feed it coal, or it sulks and goes cold.
[sigh] A warm furnace on a cold evening. Mind if I stand here a bit?
Grinding off the magic? Seems a waste, but you know best.
Keep the edge sharp and the blade lasts longer. My father taught me that.
Mind your sleeves near that wheel!
[excited] Music! Quick, somebody fetch the children, they love this one!
I haven't heard this one since the last harvest feast.
Ah, the loom! Weave me a tapestry, fellow villager!
Go bold with the colours! A plain banner is just a sheet on a stick.
We could use a new banner for the town hall. Something with a bell on it?
Make one with a creeper on it! No wait, don't do that. I'll have nightmares.
Click, clack, click. I could listen to a loom all day.
That box looks like it might bite. Does it bite?
Everything you own in one box you can carry? I need that for moving day.
A diamond sword, and you're making it even better? Some people have all the luck.
Adding a trim to your armour? Very stylish. Very not-a-villager.
Is that Netherite? It smells like a burnt-out chimney.
You'd look grand in shiny boots. I'd look grand in any boots.
Show it to our armorer when you're done, he'll want a look.
Stairs from a block of stone, just like that? Our mason takes all day!
[wincing] That screech goes right through my teeth.
Cut me a nice slab for the doorstep, would you?
Bricks, steps, slabs... is there anything that saw can't make?
Mind the dust! I just swept here.
Careful! Anvils wear out, and that one's been creaking all week.
You're feeding it experience? No wonder mine never works, I've been feeding it bread.
[gasp] The book's turning its own pages! Is it reading you?
All those floating letters... my granny said never to look them in the eye.
Shiny! Could it make my hoe better at weeding?
That light goes up so far, I bet the birds use it to find their way home.
[gasp] A pillar of light! Is the sky leaking?
Ooh, roasting something? I'll just stand here. Near it. Smelling.
That's the smoke-maker! We use it to send messages. The message is always fire, but it's a very clear message.
Mark where the good berries are. That's the important part of any map.
I've never been past the edge of our map. Is it scary out there?
[excited] A map! Can you find my house on it?
Paper, a compass, and a lot of walking. Rather you than me.
Our cauldron catches rain all spring. Free water, if you're patient.
What's going in the pot? Not my socks again, I hope.
A big iron pot! My grandmother washed the whole family in one of those.
Six books on one shelf, each in its own little slot. Tidy!
Take one out, put one back. That's the rule of the library.
Is there a book about me in there? There should be.
Bone meal from garbage!? What a time to be a villager!
Peels, stalks, old seeds — in they go, and the garden says thank you.
[sniffing] Whew, what a smell. Good for the soil, not so good for me.
That chest is cold to the touch. Like it's somewhere else entirely.
Careful! That box is leaking little purple bits everywhere.
Your things are in there, but where is 'there'? Don't answer, I'll get a headache.
Everything in its place! My wife would approve of that shelf.
Put the pretty things at eye level, so visitors notice them.
Careful where you put that, it might fall!
Sand or gravel? Either way, don't dig underneath it.
My cousin dug under gravel once. It took us all morning to dig him out.
Building by the sea? The waves will be your neighbours.
Mind the Drowned at night, they come up out of the water.
Sea air is good for you, my grandfather used to say.
A bit of green by the houses, and the whole street looks happier.
Flowers! My wife will want some for the table.
Leaves stacked like stones. Odd, but pretty.
The bees will thank you for that.
Something smells wonderful over that fire. Is there enough for two?
Turn it now and then, or one side burns and the other stays raw.
Cooking outdoors? My grandfather swore food tastes better with a bit of smoke.
Ooh, supper by the fire! Mind your sleeves.
Stay back until I figure out whether you bite.
Is it friendly? Somebody poke it. Not me.
I've lived here all my life and never seen the like.
[nervous laugh] Hello there, odd thing. Nice weather, isn't it?
Merry Christmas! Come in and warm up by the fire.
I baked a pie this morning. There's a slice for you!
The whole village smells of gingerbread today.
Fellow villager, I sense excitement in the air... or is that just my imagination again?
Tomorrow's the big day! Have you hung up your stocking?
I still haven't wrapped my presents. Don't tell anyone!
Friday at last! Tomorrow I'll sleep till the sun's high.
I spilled the salt at breakfast. Today of all days.
I'm not leaving the house until tomorrow. Just in case.
Do not step on any cracks today, fellow villager. Friday the thirteenth is most unforgiving.
A child came to my door and said trick or treat, so I panicked and gave them my house. Halloween is very expensive, fellow citizen.
I dressed up as a Zombie this year. Nobody noticed the difference, which hurts a little.
The Skeletons get a holiday tonight, and we get to lock our doors early.
Happy birthday to our blocky world! May it never run out of dirt.
They say the world was made on this very day. I baked a cake, just in case.
[excited] Every block, every tree, every Creeper... all born today!
The first day of the year! Let's make it a good one.
Happy New Year! I promised myself to trade more fairly this year.
A new year, and the same old well. Some things should never change.
[laughing] I stayed up for the new year and fell asleep right before it.
Happy New Year, strange-looking citizen! May your crops grow and your Cows stay far, far away!
Happy New Year! I wrote a list of wishes and already lost it.
Sunday! No work, just pie and a long nap.
On Sundays my whole family sits down to supper together.
Thursday. The week is tired, and so am I.
Tuesday. Monday's behind us, and the week hasn't noticed me yet. Lovely.
Happy Valentine's Day! I picked flowers for everyone. Well, for my wife, and then I ran out.
Love is in the air today. Also the smell of the composter, but mostly love.
On Valentine's Day, even the Iron Golem gets a poppy.
Wednesday! From here on, it's downhill all the way to the weekend.
Weekend! I've hidden my tools so I won't be tempted.
Ooh, no work today! Watch me relax! I am relaxing SO hard right now. Look at me go.
A Camel! I hear they go for days without a drink.
Two can ride one of those, you know. Fancy a trip?
Chewing and chewing. What is it even eating?
Look at it flap about! It wants back in the water.
Careful, if that's a pufferfish, better not touch it.
Such bright colours! Fish are prettier than folk give them credit for.
A fish this close to shore? Someone fetch the fisherman.
A Ghast that is happy! This is much better than the other ones!
Look, a cloud with eyes! And it's smiling at me!
Could it carry me over the hills, do you think?
[whisper] Don't make any sudden moves, I want it to stay.
It's so big and so gentle. I didn't know those went together.
Mind your head! It's floating down really low.
Look at that wool! You could knit a whole blanket from one llama.
A Llama! Such elegance! Such poise! Such unsettling eye contact!
Is that one carrying luggage? Where is it off to?
Ooh, it has a fancy carpet on its back!
A new chest! Don't worry, I won't peek. Much.
Good, a furnace. Will you bake us something?
It's nice and warm by one of those in winter.
Don't forget the fuel, it won't burn on hope alone.
A torch you can't warm your hands on. What good is that?
Red light... the whole street looks like sunset.
Bit dim, isn't it? That won't frighten a zombie.
Those swirls make my head spin if I look too long.
Terracotta! The glazed one even has pictures on it.
Gold, sitting right out in the open? Bold.
Put that somewhere safe, Piglins love the stuff.
That snow looks soft, but it pulls you under. Leather boots, friend, leather boots.
Kids, stay away from that one! It's not the snowball kind.
You've been under the water for ages and you're not even blue. How?
Can you teach the fisherman that trick? He keeps nearly drowning.
Are you part squid now? Just asking.
Oooh, a new hour has begun, fellow Villager! I felt it go bong inside my head. I hope that is normal.
A new hour! And every new hour deserves a little snack.
Where am I? Where's my mama?
Ooh, everything is so big and bright!
[excited] Hi! I'm new! What do I do now?
No lessons today! I can run all day long!
[excited] A workstation, and it's mine! I'm finally useful!
I've got a trade now! Come back tomorrow and see what I have.
No more wandering about. I've got work to do!
Ow! Not in my house! I just swept the floor!
Help! There's a brute in my kitchen!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.slbqfws: Hey! Leave him alone, that's his own house!
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.slbqfwb: Thank you, neighbour! Somebody fetch the Golem!
Ow! Why does this plant hate me?
Ow! Who plants these right next to the path?
[pained grunt] My head! It rang like a bell!
Ow! Somebody check the roof, things are falling off it!
That anvil missed the smith and found me instead.
Ow! I think I'm a block shorter now.
Ow! A stone icicle, right on my head!
Ow! Tomorrow I'm knocking every one of those down!
[coughing] Who keeps TNT near the houses?!
Ow! My house! Is my house still standing?
Everything's spinning. I think I'll lie down now.
Still no workstation for me. I check the village every morning, just in case.
If I had a lectern, I'd be a librarian. If I had a composter... also fine.
I asked the smithy for work. The anvil just stared at me.
I'm not unemployed, I'm just weighing my options.
Everyone's off to work, and I'm off to... this spot here. Nice spot.
Mum asks what I do all day. I say: walking. She sighs.
Anyone got a spare workstation? I'm not picky. Mostly.
I'd help the farmer, but he says I water the weeds.
Today I counted every fence post in the village. Forty-two. Busy day.
One day someone will need me. I'll be ready. Probably napping, but ready.
I better still get paid if I can't get to work!
Who put a wall between me and my work?
I can see it from here, I just can't get to it!
If nobody clears the way, my customers will think I've quit.
[sigh] I suppose today is a day off, then.
Tiny hands, tiny feet, and already the loudest one on the street.
[gasp] So small! Were we ever that small?
Somebody fetch more bread, we've got another mouth to feed!
Hello there. I'm your parent. Apparently.
First lesson: never trade at a loss.
We'll need a bigger house, won't we?
[laughing] Just born, and it already wants to run off and play!
Don't cry, don't cry, the world isn't that scary.
I promise to teach you everything I know. It won't take long.
Shh, everyone, quiet! It's about to say its first word.
Gather round, everyone! Who's heard the news from the fields?
Ah, good, I was hoping there'd be someone to talk to.
Has the mayor said anything about the new houses yet?
Quick, before the children come back: who broke the fence?
[whisper] I heard the baker's been sneaking extra honey into the bread.
Did you hear? The cleric's cauldron boiled over and turned the well purple.
So, how's everyone's week going? Mine has been mostly carrots.
Hello, neighbours! Look at us, a proper crowd.
[gasp] I can feel my heart beating again!
The fog in my head is gone. Thank you, friend.
I owe you my life. And the neighbours an apology, probably.
Was I growling at people? Please say I wasn't growling at people.
Did I ask to be cured? I was part of a likeminded community of adventurous eaters. Now what am I going to eat? Bread?
A golden apple, eh? That's the dearest meal I've ever had.
The sun doesn't burn! I'd forgotten what that feels like.
Someone tell my family I'm back, before they bar the door.
Every shelf is full. Now where do I put the new ones?
Someone put the cookbook next to the poetry again.
[sigh] Dust again. I only wiped these yesterday.
One, two, three... who borrowed book number four?
Alphabetical? By colour? I can never decide.
This one has a bent corner. Who does that to a book?
Ah, I remember reading this one. Or was it that one?
[whisper] Quiet, please. The books are resting.
[happy sigh] Work that suits my hands. What more could I ask for?
A tidy bench makes for tidy work.
Come closer, I'll show you what I made this morning.
Busy, busy! But never too busy for a customer.
Smell that? That's the smell of honest work.
If you want something special, just ask. I take orders.
[snoring] Mm... no, the red wool goes on the left...
[snoring] Grandma... I didn't eat the pie... it was the cat...
[snoring] Faster, little pig... we'll win the race this year...
[snoring, then a snort] Zzz... hnk! Who's there?
[snoring] Mm... the wheat's ripe... time to harvest...
[sleep talking] ...you can't come in, Zombie... the door's locked...
[screaming] Hot, hot, hot! Why is the floor angry?
[gasp] My heels are smoking! Who paves a path with embers?
Ow! This stone isn't glowing for nothing!
My soles! I'll need new boots after this.
I should visit my sister today. Or tomorrow. Tomorrow's good.
Clouds look heavy. Better bring the washing in.
Another day, another walk past the same well. I'm fond of that well.
And I would walk a few blocks here then will walk a few blocks more DA DA DA!
Did I feed the chickens? I think the chickens fed themselves.
The new house down the road is coming along nicely.
The baker waved at me today. Twice. Something's going on.
Someone's laid stones on this road. Nice and smooth under the feet.
Hope today's quiet. I've had enough excitement for a month.
I tried counting sheep in the daytime. Fell asleep standing up.
My grandfather used to say: walk slowly and you'll live long.
Left at the well, right at the fence, and home for supper.
The cat from the corner house follows me everywhere. I think we're friends.
I wonder what's past those hills. Probably more hills.
A bee landed on me earlier. We understood each other.
Knees feel good today. I'll take the long way round.
Hum-de-dum, a little walk, a little talk, hum-de-dum.
Nice spot, this. Good view of the fields.
If it rains tonight, the carrots will be happy.
Smell that? Somebody's cooking soup.
Just stretching my legs. They were getting bored.
Did the mayor give a speech this morning? I missed it again.
I wonder if the fish in the pond know they live in a village.
[thoughtful] Hmmm... where was I going?
[confused] Hm? Did somebody call me?
I should learn to whistle. Every proper walker whistles.
When I get home I'm putting my feet up by the fire.
Out on my rounds. Very official. Nobody asked me to.
Hello, fence! Hello, flowers! Hello, everybody!
Same village, same faces. I wouldn't swap it for anything.
Plan for today: walk, eat, nap. Maybe in that order.
My boots are wearing thin. That's the sign of a busy life.
Look, a butterfly! No, a leaf. Still nice.
The shepherd's sheep keep staring at me. I don't trust them.
Who planted flowers along here? Whoever it was, thank you.
That tree wasn't this big last year. Or was I bigger?
If I walk past the shop slowly, maybe they'll offer me a taste of something.
Why do they do that? They know things.
The ground here is the colour of old cheese. And it's floating.
[whisper] Something big is flying up there. Let's not wave.
Endermen at every step. I hear you mustn't meet their eyes.
Red sky, red rock, red everything. I miss green.
My feet are cooking right through my shoes!
There's a river of fire right there. Who thought that was a good idea?
I counted the blades of grass by the well. Then a sheep ate my count.
What if the sky is just a very big lake, and we're the fish?
Today I'll do something great. Maybe after lunch.
I asked a chicken for advice. It walked away. Wise bird.
If I stand still long enough, maybe they'll hire me as a fence post.
I talk to the moon at night. It never interrupts.
I dug a hole yesterday. Today I'm admiring it.
I planted an emerald. Nothing has come up yet.
The children made me the monster in their game again. I'm getting good at growling.
Everyone has a job but me. I have time, and that's a job too.
I found a button once and didn't press it. I think about that every now and again.
Grandpa said if you whistle at night, the Phantoms whistle back. I'm too scared to try.
My robe is green because I'm still growing, like a sprout.
If you walk far enough, do you come back from the other side? I'll check tomorrow.
Would you like to become a nitwit? I have a pamphlet!
What a full day! I've done nothing, and it took ages.
Is a door still a door if nobody walks through it? Deep, isn't it?
I'm in charge of watching clouds. Nobody gave me the job, so nobody can take it away.
I once shook hands with the Golem. Well, he shook me.
I found a pebble that looks just like a pebble. Amazing.
I used to be a farmer but I'm on my gap year!
Where's my bed? Which house is mine?!
Somebody ring the bell!
Where's the Iron Golem when you need him?!
My knees are shaking so hard I can hear them!
Lock the doors! Lock all the doors!
[scared] I'm too young for this! Well, middle-aged!
What is that?! Don't tell me, just run!
[screaming] Aaaah! Monsters!
[screaming] Help! Heeelp!
[panicked scream] Drop everything and run!
[shrieking] Eeeek! Not again!
Inside, inside, everybody inside!
[gasp] Oh, my word!
Who left the gate open?!
Which way is safe? Every way looks scary!
I dropped my bread! Leave it, leave the bread!
Abandon village! Everyone abandon the village!
I'm built for trading, not for this!
Why does this always happen on washing day?
Get behind a wall! Any wall!
Where's the night watch? Wake the watch!
[whimpering] I want my mum.
Don't look at me! I'm not here! I'm a fence post!
It's time to go home, but home is very, very far away.
No sun, no moon. How do I know when it's bedtime here?
My bed is a whole world away. I'll have to curl up on this cold stone.
[sad] I miss my bed. And my village. And grass.
Put it low, please. The children love buttons. So do I.
What does it open? Can I press it?
Oh! A visitor. Mind the chickens, they peck.
You've walked a long way, haven't you? Your boots are all muddy.
If you're after bread, the baker's sold out again.
Don't mind me, I'm not important.
Hello, hello!
Look, everyone, a new face!
I'm off to borrow some firewood. Borrow. Not take.
You look tired. There's a bench by the well, have a sit.
Hmm, you're not from around here. I'd remember that walk.
Hello! Where do people dress like that? Must be a long way off.
Oh! You gave me a fright. For a moment I thought you were a Zombie.
A good day to you, traveller.
Well, look who's here!
Hello, friend. Staying long?
Have you seen a ginger cat? She's stolen my fish again.
Hello, neighbour.
Oh, hi. I didn't hear you coming.
[friendly] Hey, you! Yes, you. Hello!
Hey there, stranger.
I've no Emeralds to spare, but if you want a good trade, I'm your man. Probably.
You look well! Our air must agree with you.
Oh! Hello. I was just counting my potatoes.
Bless my boots, a traveller!
[nervous laugh] A stranger... I'll just stand behind this fence.
Welcome! Please wipe your feet before you go in anywhere.
Come to see us? We don't get many visitors, so smile, everyone's looking.
Come in, come in, don't be shy.
Sun's up? Then I'll do today's work with my eyes half shut.
Morning? But I only just lay down!
Where did the night go? Somebody stole my sleep.
Stop! My wife's waiting at home, and she's scarier than you!
Ow! I'm a farmer, not a fighter!
Careful, I bruise like a ripe melon!
Fine, fine, take my bread, just stop!
That's no way to ask for a discount!
Ow! Count to ten next time, would you?
Ow! What did I ever do to you?
And here I thought you were nice.
Let's talk it over, like sensible folk!
Stop it! I've still got crops to water!
Please! Who'll feed my chickens if I'm gone?
Put that blade away, I'm unarmed!
[scared] Steel against my soft arms? That's hardly a fair fight!
Ow! That's sharp! That's very sharp!
Ah, you've got an eye for quality!
I made that one myself, you know.
Careful, it's still warm from the workshop.
[laughing] My wife will be glad to see these Emeralds!
I'll write it in my ledger. You're my best customer this week.
One Emerald closer to a new roof!
Use it well, and tell me how it goes!
Hmm, are you sure you need that many?
A panda cub! Look at it roll!
Did it just sneeze? [laughing] It scared itself!
Black and white and round all over.
Look at it chewing bamboo with its eyes shut. Pure bliss.
Can I keep it? I'll grow bamboo for it, I promise!
Off you go to the flowers, little worker.
Stay still, stay still... it only wants the flowers.
If you find any honey, bring some back for me!
[whisper] Hear that hum? It's like the whole meadow is purring.
Don't land on me, little bee, I've nothing sweet. Well, one cookie.
That Bee works harder than half the village.
A Drowned crawled out of the river! Get away from the bank!
[scared] Their eyes glow under the water. I saw them last night and thought I'd dreamt it.
[scared] It has a trident! Don't let it throw that thing!
That one smells like a forgotten fish barrel.
I'm never swimming in that lake again.
Look how skinny it is under all that fluff!
It'll grow back. Just keep eating grass, friend.
Brr, I feel cold just looking at it.
Its wool is in somebody's blanket now. A fair swap, I suppose.
Easy, wolf. I taste terrible, I promise.
It's staring at the chickens. I don't like that look.
Maybe it would be friendlier if someone gave it a bone?
Keep the lambs in the pen tonight, there's a wolf about.
[nervous laugh] Nice wolf. Good wolf. Please go away, wolf.
Look at those ears. If it didn't look so hungry, I'd call it handsome.
A wolf all on its own... where's the rest of the pack, I wonder?
It still smells of smoke, wherever it came from.
Don't look at it. Hit one, and the whole crowd comes after you.
It's got a golden sword. And no manners.
Half its face is gone, and it's still grumbling at me.
[whisper] Walk slowly. Don't swing anything. Don't even sneeze.
It came out of that purple portal. I knew that thing meant trouble.
Those wings could blow the roof off the bakery.
I thought dragons only lived in grandmother's stories!
Its roar knocked the dishes off my shelf, all the way from here!
Purple eyes, black wings... it came from the End, didn't it?
[angry] Go back to your tower, you brute!
[angry] Ow! I'll be pulling bolts out of my door for a week!
[screaming] It's as big as a house! Run!
Ow! That brute trampled my crops, and now me!
[scared] Where's the golem when you need one?!
It flung me like a sack of potatoes!
My socks are soaked through. Wonderful.
[disgusted] Ugh, it's squelching between my toes.
Who left a puddle in the middle of the path?
Every frog in the village is laughing at me right now.
It's only ankle deep, I know. I still don't like it.
Cool water on a hot day. Not so bad, really.
[nervous laugh] I'll just walk faster and pretend this isn't happening.
Little fish, don't nibble my heels, please.
The hem of my robe is getting wet!
Now I'll squelch all the way home.
Everyone, a step back, please! I can't breathe!
[scared] Let me out! I don't like tight places!
Whose elbow is that? It's in my ribs.
I came for the gossip, not to be squeezed like an apple!
Stop shoving! There's no room to shove!
Somebody here had onions for lunch.
This is worse than market day.
Too tight! I'm getting squashed flat!
Someone's on my foot! Whoever you are, I forgive you, just move.
Is this a festival? Nobody told me there was a festival.
Who herded us all in here like sheep?
Even the cactus looks thirsty, and that's saying something.
I've drunk three buckets of water and I'm still thirsty.
My shirt is stuck to my back. Lovely.
Is there any shade around here, or did the sun eat it all?
You look... different. Did you change your mind about something important?
Was that some kind of spell? Are you a Cleric?
[nervous laugh] You blinked very strangely just now. Are you all right?
[whisper] Is it a game? I'll crouch too. Just tell me the rules.
You'll hurt your back walking bent over like that.
Sneaking up on someone? I won't tell.
[laughing] You look like a chicken hunting for seeds.
Did you drop something? I can help you look.
Creeping about my village like that makes me nervous.
You can barely lift that sword. Want me to hold it for you?
Right now my grandmother could carry more firewood than you.
[gasp] You're as pale as milk. Sit down before you fall over.
You've been looking at me so long, I forgot what I was doing.
I'm blushing. Can you tell? I'm blushing.
Do I owe you emeralds? Is that what this is?
[nervous laugh] Nice weather, huh? Huh? Say something.
If you want to trade, just say so. No need to stare.
Fine. I'll stare back. Ready? Go.
My mother looked at me like that when I broke a pot.
Am I in your way? I can move. I'll move.
[whisper] Is there a monster behind me? Don't lie.
If you're memorising me for a portrait, at least get my good side.
You're making the chickens nervous. And me.
Stop it. I can feel your eyes on the back of my head.
Have we met? You look at me like we've met.
Building here? Everything around wants to burn it down.
It's so hot here I don't even want soup.
Please build us a way home first.
OOOH! It's meant to be scary where you got that!
[nervous laugh] That block's still warm. Where exactly have you been walking?
They say it doesn't even burn in lava. Imagine a cooking pot made of that!
That's not iron. Darker... heavier... what is it?
They say that metal comes from the Nether. I believe it.
A block like that could buy our whole village. Twice.
Don't leave it out overnight, someone will try to carry it off.
Smooth as a frozen pond. Hard as one, too.
Not a crack, not a pebble. Did you pour it or bake it?
Nine diamonds in one block? Where did you dig those up?
[whisper] Don't let the trader see this, or his prices will go up.
I'd trade my whole house for that block.
Look how it flaps! It can't decide which way is up.
[nervous laugh] Shoo, little flapper, go back where it's dark.
It's squeaking at me. I think it's scolding me for being awake.
Sleeps upside down all day and still looks cheerful. I envy that.
A Slime! Hop away, Hop away!
Don't step in it! Last time I scraped it off my shoe for a week.
A slime! Oh no, it's bouncing towards me!
Careful, big fellow, that's my garden you're digging up.
Hey, a Sniffer! What a peculiar beast.
Such an old, old creature. My grandmother told stories about beasts like you.
Look, a Sniffer! It walks so slowly.
It dug up a seed nobody's seen in ages. I wonder what grows from it.
[whisper] If I hum a tune, do you think it will dance for me?
It brought back the stick I dropped. Nobody in this village does that!
An Allay! Quick, give them an item, it's the rules!
Look! An Allay! They are much prettier than a Cow, that's for certain.
Oh hello there, Allay! Are you looking for something shiny?
is it... is it safe now?
Well, that's a story for supper tonight.
[sigh] Right. Back to work, I suppose.
I think I'll sit down for a bit.
Ahh I feel so much better now that's finished.
[sigh] Somebody remind me where I left my basket before all that.
I'm far too old for this sort of excitement.
Friday! I'll finish early and sit on the porch till sunset.
One last push this week. Then the week can look after itself.
Friday means fresh pies at the bakery. I've been saving room all week.
Is it Friday? I can tell. Everyone's walking a little slower.
Make something nice! A chair, maybe. We never have enough chairs.
My grandfather built this whole house at a table like that.
If you're making a door, ours squeaks. Just saying.
What are you making? Can I watch? I won't touch anything.
Nobody in the village could make one of those. Not even the smith.
That block feels wrong. Like it's not from our world.
I've traded all my life and never seen one of those on any stall.
Look, a dolphin! It's smiling at us!
It swims circles round the boats, like it's teasing them.
They say if you swim beside one, it leads you to treasure.
It leapt right out of the water! Did you see?
Toss it a fish, maybe it'll stay and play.
I'd give a week's bread to swim like that.
[startled] Ow! That wasn't part of the game!
[crying loudly] But I didn't do anything wrong!
[relieved sigh] Is it gone? Really gone? Okay. Good.
Ahhh, I feel so much better now that it's finished.
I wasn't scared. Well, only a tiny bit.
Can I have a hug now? Just a small one.
I'm gonna tell Mum all about it!
Ahhh. That thing that happened is no longer happening. Yay!
[coughing] I was stuck in there like a nail in a plank. Thank you!
[scared] It bit me! Am I going green? Tell me I'm not going green!
Ow! Its hands are freezing cold!
[angry] Hands off! I still need this arm!
Ugh, it smells even worse up close.
Help! It hit me and it's coming back for more!
Fetch the cleric, quick, before I start groaning too!
My robe's on fire! Roll, roll... where do I roll?
[pained grunt] Oof! I meant to take the stairs!
[pained grunt] Ow! Why did the floor hit me like that?
[groaning] My knees will remind me of this all week.
Ow! Next time I climb down slowly, like Grandpa.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.life_ho: I know every board in here by its creak.
I sleep here, and nowhere else.
The door is mine. So is the bed.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_avo: Mum says when I see you, I walk the other way.
I'm not scared of you! I'm just leaving.
Don't come closer, or I'll scream!
Mom, that one is back again!
Say sorry to everyone, then we can play.
You broke Dad's garden, I remember.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_ama: [gasp] Is that magic? Are you a secret wizard?
[excited] When I grow up, I want to be just like you!
I'm telling everyone! Nobody will believe me!
That's the coolest thing I've ever seen!
My papa can't do that. Don't tell him I said so.
My mouth fell open. Look, it's still open!
You must be the strongest in the world.
Can I touch it? Just a little?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_pla: Catch me! You can't catch me!
I'm a knight, and this stick is my sword!
Ready or not, here I come!
The floor is lava! Don't step on it!
I found a bug! His name is Bob.
La, la, la, I'm singing a song!
Look how I can jump!
Let's play shopkeepers!
I'm the fastest in the village!
This is my secret base. Don't tell anyone.
I'm collecting pebbles. I already have three!
Last one there is a rotten egg!
Today I'm a dragon. Rawr!
I'm building a house out of sticks. Want to be my neighbour?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_bed: I'm not sleepy. Not even a bit. Yaaawn.
There's nobody under the bed, right?
I'll count the stars until I fall asleep. One... two...
Can I take the kitty to bed?
I'll sleep with my eyes open. To watch for monsters.
It's dark already? I just started playing!
I'm going to dream about a dragon. A nice one.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.w_trade: A great deal! Come again.
Thank you! Now I can buy the kids new boots.
I'll tell the neighbours you pay fair. That counts for a lot here.
Here you go. And don't lose it on the way.
Emerald by emerald, maybe we'll save up for a new house.
Good trading! Come by for pies sometime.
You're an honest customer. There aren't many.
Didn't take anything? Oh well.
Just came to look? It happens.
Just looking again? Fine, I'll put the best ones aside for you.
Hmm… your loss. The goods are great.
All right, another time.
I'm not just standing here to look pretty, you know.
Ah! And in my clean apron, too!
Where's a plantain leaf when I need one?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.kid_ans: You came so fast, Mama! Were you running?
Blow on it one more time, please.
I won't run so far away again.
Will I get a cookie for being brave?
Oh, morning already? Just one more minute…
Let's see what the hens have left me this morning.
What a wonderful dream I had!
I'm up, I'm up. Well, almost.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_m_gru: Can't a man take his boots off before the shouting starts?
I worked all day, you know!
It wasn't me who ate the last bread. Well, mostly not me.
All right, all right, I get it. I'll be quiet.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.n_young: I'm grown up! Now I can stay out late!
Is that candle for me? Then I'm making a very big wish.
Thank you, Mum. Thank you, Dad. I love you.
So, where do they hand out houses of your own?
It all went so fast! Only yesterday I played with dolls.
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.o_k_pet: Who's a good one? You are!
You can sleep at the foot of my bed tonight. Don't tell Mum.
A scratch behind the ears. Like it?
subtitles.villager_life.dialogue.r_w_385: Not a single bed here, just stones and darkness.
I'll make a pillow of my apron and pretend I'm home.
